summary_zh: 超分辨率（SR）模型在硬件限制下增强微创手术和诊断视频方面越来越引起关注。然而，人们对其可能引入幻觉结构并放大噪声的担忧依然存在，这限制了其在安全关键场景中的可靠性。我们提出了一个直接且实用的框架，通过识别重建可能失败的位置来提高SR系统的可信度。我们的方法集成了一个轻量级误差预测网络，该网络在中间表示上运行，以估计逐像素的重建误差。该模块计算效率高且延迟低，适合实时部署。我们通过构建共形失败掩膜（CFM）将这些预测转换为操作失败决策，从而定位不应信任SR输出的区域。基于共形风险控制原则，我们的方法为控制容错限值和检测失败中的错误覆盖率提供了理论保证。我们在图像和视频SR上评估了我们的方法，展示了其在内镜和机器人手术场景中检测不可靠重建的有效性。据我们所知，这是首次提供一种与模型无关的、有理论基础的提高实时内镜图像SR安全性的方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to make endoscopic super-resolution systems trustworthy by using a lightweight error-prediction network to estimate pixel-wise reconstruction errors and generating Conformal Failure Masks (CFM) to localize untrustworthy regions, with theoretical guarantees from conformal risk control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，通过使用轻量级误差预测网络估计像素级重建误差，并生成一致性失败掩模(CFM)来定位不可信区域，从而使内镜超分辨率系统更加可信，并具有来自一致性风险控制的理论保证。

title: Locomotion of an Elastic Snake Robot via Natural Dynamics
summary: Nature suggests that exploiting the elasticities and natural dynamics of robotic systems could increase their locomotion efficiency. Prior work on elastic snake robots supports this hypothesis, but has not fully exploited the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the systems. Recent advances in eigenmanifold theory enable a better characterization of the natural dynamics in complex nonlinear systems. This letter investigates if and how the nonlinear natural dynamics of a kinematic elastic snake robot can be used to design efficient gaits. Two types of gaits based on natural dynamics are presented and compared to a state-of-the-art approach using dynamics simulations. The results reveal that a gait generated by switching between two nonlinear normal modes does not improve the locomotion efficiency of the robot. In contrast, gaits based on non-brake periodic trajectories (non-brake orbits) are perfectly efficient in the energy-conservative case. Further simulations with friction reveal that, in a more realistic scenario, non-brake orbit gaits achieve higher efficiency compared to the baseline gait on the rigid system. Overall, the investigation offers promising insights into the design of gaits based on natural dynamics, fostering further research.
summary_zh:
摘要：
自然界表明，利用机器人系统的弹性和固有动力学可以提高其运动效率。之前关于弹性蛇形机器人的研究支持这一假设，但尚未完全挖掘系统的非线性动态行为。本征流形理论的最新进展能够更好地表征复杂非线性系统中的固有动力学。本文研究运动弹性蛇形机器人的非线性固有动力学是否可以以及如何用于设计高效步态。提出了两种基于固有动力的步态，并通过动力学仿真与现有先进方法进行了比较。结果表明，在两种非线性正规模态之间切换产生的步态并不能提高机器人的运动效率。相反，基于非制动周期轨迹（非制动轨道）的步态在能量守恒情况下非常高效。进一步的摩擦仿真表明，在更现实的场景中，非制动轨道步态与刚性系统的基准步态相比具有更高的效率。总体而言，该研究为基于固有动力学设计步态提供了有价值的见解，并促进了进一步的研究。
tldr: The paper explores using the nonlinear natural dynamics of an elastic snake robot to design energy‑efficient gaits, finding that non‑brake periodic trajectories outperform switching between nonlinear normal modes and a baseline rigid approach.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了利用弹性蛇形机器人的非线性固有动力学来设计节能步态，发现非制动周期轨迹在能效上优于切换非线性正则模态及刚性基准步态。

title: Sharpening Lightweight Models for Generalized Polyp Segmentation: A Boundary Guided Distillation from Foundation Models
summary: Automated polyp segmentation is critical for early colorectal cancer detection and its prevention, yet remains challenging due to weak boundaries, large appearance variations, and limited annotated data. Lightweight segmentation models such as U-Net, U-Net++, and PraNet offer practical efficiency for clinical deployment but struggle to capture the rich semantic and structural cues required for accurate delineation of complex polyp regions. In contrast, large Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), including SAM, OneFormer, Mask2Former, and DINOv2, exhibit strong generalization but transfer poorly to polyp segmentation due to domain mismatch, insufficient boundary sensitivity, and high computational cost. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{\textbf{LiteBounD}, a \underline{Li}gh\underline{t}w\underline{e}ight \underline{Boun}dary-guided \underline{D}istillation} framework that transfers complementary semantic and structural priors from multiple VFMs into compact segmentation backbones. LiteBounD introduces (i) a dual-path distillation mechanism that disentangles semantic and boundary-aware representations, (ii) a frequency-aware alignment strategy that supervises low-frequency global semantics and high-frequency boundary details separately, and (iii) a boundary-aware decoder that fuses multi-scale encoder features with distilled semantically rich boundary information for precise segmentation. Extensive experiments on both seen (Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicDB) and unseen (ColonDB, CVC-300, ETIS) datasets demonstrate that LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use. Our code is available at https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD.
summary_zh:
摘要：
自动息肉分割对早期结直肠癌检测及其预防至关重要，但由于边界模糊、外观差异大以及标注数据有限等因素，该任务仍然具有挑战性。U-Net、U-Net++和PraNet等轻量级分割模型在临床部署中具有实用效率优势，但难以捕捉精确勾勒复杂息肉区域所需的丰富语义和结构线索。相比之下，大型视觉基础模型（VFMs），包括SAM、OneFormer、Mask2Former和DINOv2，表现出较强的泛化能力，但由于领域不匹配、边界敏感性不足以及计算成本高等问题，难以有效迁移到息肉分割任务。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了LiteBounD（轻量级边界引导蒸馏框架），该框架将多个视觉基础模型的互补语义和结构先验知识迁移到紧凑的分割主干网络中。LiteBounD引入了（i）双路径蒸馏机制，用于解耦语义和边界感知表示；（ii）频率感知对齐策略，分别监督低频全局语义和高频边界细节；（iii）边界感知解码器，将多尺度编码器特征与蒸馏的语义丰富边界信息融合，以实现精确分割。在可见数据集（Kvasir-SEG、CVC-ClinicDB）和不可见数据集（ColonDB、CVC-300、ETIS）上的大量实验表明，LiteBounD始终以显著优势超越其轻量级基线方法，并达到与最先进方法相当的性能，同时保持了实时临床使用所需的效率。我们的代码可访问 https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD。
tldr: We propose LiteBounD, a lightweight boundary‑guided distillation framework that extracts semantic and boundary knowledge from large vision foundation models and transfers it to compact polyp segmentation networks, achieving state‑of‑the‑art accuracy while preserving real‑time clinical efficiency.
tldr_zh: 我们提出了LiteBounD，一个轻量级的边界引导蒸馏框架，将大型视觉基础模型的语义和边界知识迁移到紧凑的结肠息肉分割网络中，在保持实时临床效率的同时实现了先进的分割精度。

title: AI-Enabled Image-Based Hybrid Vision/Force Control of Tendon-Driven Aerial Continuum Manipulators
summary: This paper presents an AI-enabled cascaded hybrid vision/force control framework for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators based on constant-strain modeling in $SE(3)$ as a coupled system. The proposed controller is designed to enable autonomous, physical interaction with a static environment while stabilizing the image feature error. The developed strategy combines the cascaded fast fixed-time sliding mode control and a radial basis function neural network to cope with the uncertainties in the image acquired by the eye-in-hand monocular camera and the measurements from the force sensing apparatus. This ensures rapid, online learning of the vision- and force-related uncertainties without requiring offline training. Furthermore, the features are extracted via a state-of-the-art graph neural network architecture employed by a visual servoing framework using line features, rather than relying on heuristic geometric line extractors, to concurrently contribute to tracking the desired normal interaction force during contact and regulating the image feature error. A comparative study benchmarks the proposed controller against established rigid-arm aerial manipulation methods, evaluating robustness across diverse scenarios and feature extraction strategies. The simulation and experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed methodology under various initial conditions and demonstrate robust performance in executing manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SE(3)常应变建模的腱驱动空中连续体机械臂级联混合视觉/力控制框架。该控制器的设计目标是实现与静态环境的自主物理交互，同时稳定图像特征误差。所开发的策略结合了级联快速固定时间滑模控制和径向基函数神经网络，以应对手眼单目相机获取的图像及力传感装置测量中的不确定性。这确保了视觉和力相关不确定性的快速在线学习，无需离线训练。此外，特征提取采用视觉伺服框架中先进的图神经网络架构，使用直线特征而非启发式几何直线提取器，从而在跟踪期望的法向接触力和调节图像特征误差方面同时发挥作用。一项对比研究将所提出的控制器与成熟的刚性臂空中操作方法进行了基准测试，评估了其在不同场景和特征提取策略下的鲁棒性。仿真和实验结果验证了所提方法在不同初始条件下的有效性，并展示了其在执行操作任务时的鲁棒性能。
tldr: This paper introduces an AI‑enabled hybrid vision/force controller for tendon‑driven aerial continuum manipulators, combining cascaded fast fixed‑time sliding‑mode control, RBF neural networks, and a graph‑neural‑network‑based visual servoing scheme to achieve autonomous physical interaction while stabilizing image‑feature error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对腱驱动空中连续体机械手的AI混合视觉/力控制框架，结合级联快速固定时间滑模控制、径向基函数神经网络以及基于图神经网络的视觉伺服，实现自主物理交互并稳定图像特征误差。

title: An AI Agent Execution Environment to Safeguard User Data
summary:
AI agents promise to serve as general-purpose personal assistants for their users, which requires them to have access to private user data (e.g., personal and financial information). This poses a serious risk to security and privacy. Adversaries may attack the AI model (e.g., via prompt injection) to exfiltrate user data. Furthermore, sharing private data with an AI agent requires users to trust a potentially unscrupulous or compromised AI model provider with their private data.
  This paper presents GAAP (Guaranteed Accounting for Agent Privacy), an execution environment for AI agents that guarantees confidentiality for private user data. Through dynamic and directed user prompts, GAAP collects permission specifications from users describing how their private data may be shared, and GAAP enforces that the agent's disclosures of private user data, including disclosures to the AI model and its provider, comply with these specifications. Crucially, GAAP provides this guarantee deterministically, without trusting the agent with private user data, and without requiring any AI model or the user prompt to be free of attacks.
  GAAP enforces the user's permission specification by tracking how the AI agent accesses and uses private user data. It augments Information Flow Control with novel persistent data stores and annotations that enable it to track the flow of private information both across execution steps within a single task, and also over multiple tasks separated in time. Our evaluation confirms that GAAP blocks all data disclosure attacks, including those that make other state-of-the-art systems disclose private user data to untrusted parties, without a significant impact on agent utility.
summary_zh:
AI代理有望成为用户的通用个人助手，这要求它们能够访问用户的私人数据（例如个人和财务信息）。这带来了严重的安全和隐私风险。攻击者可能会攻击AI模型（例如通过提示注入）来窃取用户数据。此外，将私人数据共享给AI代理需要用户信任可能不道德或已被攻破的AI模型提供商来处理他们的私人数据。

本文提出了GAAP（代理隐私保障核算），这是一种为AI代理提供执行环境，能够保证用户私人数据的机密性。通过动态且有针对性的用户提示，GAAP从用户那里收集权限规范，描述用户的私人数据可以如何被共享，并强制执行代理对用户私人数据的披露（包括向AI模型及其提供商的披露）符合这些规范。关键在于，GAAP确定性 地提供这一保证，无需信任代理会保护用户私人数据，也无需假设AI模型或用户提示不受攻击。

GAAP通过追踪AI代理如何访问和使用用户私人数据来执行用户的权限规范。它将信息流控制与新颖的持久数据存储和注解相结合，使其能够追踪私人信息在单个任务执行步骤之间以及在时间上分隔的多个任务中的流动。我们的评估证实，GAAP能够阻止所有数据泄露攻击，包括那些导致其他最先进的系统向不可信方披露用户私人数据的攻击，同时对代理的实用性没有显著影响。
tldr: This paper presents GAAP, an execution environment for AI agents that guarantees user data confidentiality by collecting user permission specifications and enforcing data disclosure policies through information flow control, blocking all data disclosure attacks without trusting the AI model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GAAP（代理隐私保障记账），这是一种AI代理执行环境，通过收集用户权限规范并通过信息流控制执行数据泄露策略，在不信任AI模型的情况下保障用户数据机密性，阻止所有数据泄露攻击。

title: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Adaptive Ultrasound-Guided Needle Insertion and Needle Tracking
summary: Ultrasound (US)-guided needle insertion is a critical yet challenging procedure due to dynamic imaging conditions and difficulties in needle visualization. Many methods have been proposed for automated needle insertion, but they often rely on hand-crafted pipelines with modular controllers, whose performance degrades in challenging cases. In this paper, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model is proposed for adaptive and automated US-guided needle insertion and tracking on a robotic ultrasound (RUS) system. This framework provides a unified approach to needle tracking and needle insertion control, enabling real-time, dynamically adaptive adjustment of insertion based on the obtained needle position and environment awareness. To achieve real-time and end-to-end tracking, a Cross-Depth Fusion (CDF) tracking head is proposed, integrating shallow positional and deep semantic features from the large-scale vision backbone. To adapt the pretrained vision backbone for tracking tasks, a Tracking-Conditioning (TraCon) register is introduced for parameter-efficient feature conditioning. After needle tracking, an uncertainty-aware control policy and an asynchronous VLA pipeline are presented for adaptive needle insertion control, ensuring timely decision-making for improved safety and outcomes. Extensive experiments on both needle tracking and insertion show that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art trackers and manual operation, achieving higher tracking accuracy, improved insertion success rates, and reduced procedure time, highlighting promising directions for RUS-based intelligent intervention.
summary_zh: 超声（US）引导下的穿刺是一项关键但具有挑战性的操作，其原因在于成像条件的动态变化以及穿刺针可视化存在的困难。许多方法已被提出用于自动穿刺，但这些方法通常依赖于人工设计的流水线搭配模块化控制器，其在挑战性病例中性能会下降。本文提出了一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用于在机器人超声（RUS）系统中实现自适应和自动化的超声引导穿刺及跟踪。该框架提供了穿刺跟踪与穿刺控制的统一方法，能够根据获取的穿刺针位置和环境感知实现实时、动态自适应的穿刺调整。为实现实时端到端跟踪，本文提出了跨深度融合（CDF）跟踪头，整合了大规模视觉骨干网络中的浅层位置特征和深层语义特征。为将预训练的视觉骨干网络适配于跟踪任务，引入了跟踪条件化（TraCon）寄存器，用于实现参数高效的特征条件化。在穿刺针跟踪之后，提出了一种不确定性感知控制策略和异步VLA流水线，用于自适应穿刺控制，确保及时决策以提高安全性和操作结果。在穿刺针跟踪和穿刺插入的大量实验中，本文方法始终优于最先进的跟踪器和人工操作，实现了更高的跟踪准确率、更高的穿刺成功率和更短的手术时间，突显了基于RUS的智能介入诊疗的 promising 发展方向。

title: ETac: A Lightweight and Efficient Tactile Simulation Framework for Learning Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensors are increasingly integrated into dexterous robotic manipulators to enhance contact perception. However, learning manipulation policies that rely on tactile sensing remains challenging, primarily due to the trade-off between fidelity and computational cost of soft-body simulations. To address this, we present ETac, a tactile simulation framework that models elastomeric soft-body interactions with both high fidelity and efficiency. ETac employs a lightweight data-driven deformation propagation model to capture soft-body contact dynamics, achieving high simulation quality and boosting efficiency that enables large-scale policy training. When serving as the simulation backend, ETac produces surface deformation estimates comparable to FEM and demonstrates applicability for modeling real tactile sensors. Then, we showcase its capability in training a blind grasping policy that leverages large-area tactile feedback to manipulate diverse objects. Running on a single RTX 4090 GPU, ETac supports reinforcement learning across 4,096 parallel environments, achieving a total throughput of 869 FPS. The resulting policy reaches an average success rate of 84.45% across four object types, underscoring ETac's potential to make tactile-based skill learning both efficient and scalable.
summary_zh: 触觉传感器正越来越多地集成到灵巧机械手中，以增强接触感知。然而，依赖触觉传感的操纵策略学习仍然具有挑战性，主要原因在于软体仿真的保真度与计算成本之间的权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ETac——一个触觉仿真框架，能够以高保真度和高效性建模弹性体软体交互。ETac采用轻量级数据驱动的变形传播模型来捕捉软体接触动力学，实现了高质量仿真并提升了效率，从而支持大规模策略训练。作为仿真后端，ETac产生的表面变形估计可与有限元法相媲美，并展现出用于建模真实触觉传感器的适用性。随后，我们展示了其在训练盲抓取策略方面的能力——该策略利用大面积触觉反馈来操作多样化的物体。在单块RTX 4090 GPU上运行，ETac支持在4096个并行环境中进行强化学习，达到869 FPS的总吞吐量。所得到的策略在四种物体类型上达到了84.45%的平均成功率，凸显了ETac使触觉技能学习变得高效且可扩展的潜力。
tldr: ETac is a lightweight data-driven tactile simulation framework that models elastomeric soft-body contacts with high fidelity and efficiency, enabling large-scale reinforcement learning for blind grasping on a single GPU, achieving an 84.45% success rate across diverse objects.
tldr_zh: ETac是一种轻量级、数据驱动的触觉仿真框架，能够以高保真度和高效能模拟弹性软体接触，支持在单块GPU上进行大规模强化学习的盲抓取策略，在多种物体上实现了84.45%的成功率。

title: Toward Safe Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Interventions using World Models
summary: Autonomous mechanical thrombectomy (MT) presents substantial challenges due to highly variable vascular geometries and the requirements for accurate, real-time control. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for the automation of endovascular navigation, existing approaches often show limited robustness when faced with diverse patient anatomies or extended navigation horizons. In this work, we investigate a world-model-based framework for autonomous endovascular navigation built on TD-MPC2, a model-based RL method that integrates planning and learned dynamics. We evaluate a TD-MPC2 agent trained on multiple navigation tasks across hold out patient-specific vasculatures and benchmark its performance against the state-of-the-art Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm agent. Both approaches are further validated in vitro using patient-specific vascular phantoms under fluoroscopic guidance. In simulation, TD-MPC2 demonstrates a significantly higher mean success rate than SAC (58% vs. 36%, p < 0.001), and mean tip contact forces of 0.15 N, well below the proposed 1.5 N vessel rupture threshold. Mean success rates for TD-MPC2 (68%) were comparable to SAC (60%) in vitro, but TD-MPC2 achieved superior path ratios (p = 0.017) at the cost of longer procedure times (p < 0.001). Together, these results provide the first demonstration of autonomous MT navigation validated across both hold out in silico data and fluoroscopy-guided in vitro experiments, highlighting the promise of world models for safe and generalizable AI-assisted endovascular interventions.
summary_zh: 自主机械取栓术（MT）因血管几何形态的高度变异性和精确实时控制的要求而面临重大挑战。尽管强化学习（RL）已成为血管内导航自动化的有前景范式，但现有方法在面对多样化的患者解剖结构或延长的导航范围时往往表现出有限的鲁棒性。本工作研究了一种基于世界模型的自主血管内导航框架，该框架建立在TD-MPC2之上，一种集成了规划与学习动力学的基于模型的强化学习方法。我们在留出的患者特异性血管结构上评估了针对多个导航任务训练的TD-MPC2代理，并将其性能与最先进的软策略演员-评论家（SAC）算法代理进行了基准测试。两种方法均在荧光透视引导下使用患者特异性血管模型进行了体外验证。在模拟中，TD-MPC2的平均成功率显著高于SAC（58% vs. 36%，p < 0.001），平均尖端接触力为0.15 N，远低于提出的1.5 N血管破裂阈值。体外实验中，TD-MPC2的平均成功率（68%）与SAC（60%）相当，但TD-MPC2实现了更优的路径比率（p = 0.017），代价是更长的手术时间（p < 0.001）。这些结果首次提供了在留出的硅内数据和荧光透视引导的体外实验中得到验证的自主MT导航演示，突出了世界模型在安全且可泛化的人工智能辅助血管内干预中的前景。
tldr: This work introduces a world‑model‑based reinforcement learning agent (TD‑MPC2) for autonomous mechanical thrombectomy, showing higher success rates and lower tip‑contact forces than a state‑of‑the‑art SAC agent in both simulated and in‑vitro patient‑specific vasculature.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于世界模型的强化学习代理（TD‑MPC2）用于自动机械取栓，在模拟和体外患者特异性血管模型中展示了比SAC更高的成功率和更低的尖端接触力。

title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.
summary_zh: 自主医疗机器人有望改善患者预后、减轻医护人员负担、普及医疗服务并实现超越人类的精度。然而，自动医疗机器人技术一直受到一个根本性数据问题的制约：现有的医疗机器人数据集规模小、单一机器人形态、且很少公开共享，限制了领域发展所需的基础模型的开发。我们推出Open-H-Embodiment，这是迄今为止规模最大的医疗机器人视频同步运动学公开数据集，涵盖49家机构和多个机器人平台，包括CMR Versius、Intuitive Surgical的da Vinci、da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）、Rob Surgical BiTrack、Virtual Incision的MIRA、Moon Surgical Maestro以及各种定制系统，涵盖手术操作、机器人超声和内镜检查程序。我们通过两个基础模型展示了该数据集所支持的研究。GR00T-H是首个用于医疗机器人的开源基础视觉-语言-动作模型，也是唯一在结构化缝合基准测试中实现完整端到端任务完成的评估模型（25%的试验成功率，而其他所有模型均为0%），并在29步体外缝合序列中达到64%的平均成功率。我们还训练了Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator，这是首个动作条件的世界模型，能够从单一检查点实现多机器人形态的外科模拟，涵盖九个机器人平台，并支持医疗领域的虚拟策略评估和合成数据生成。这些结果表明，开放、大规模的医疗机器人数据收集可以作为研究界的关键基础设施，推动机器人学习、世界建模等领域的发展。
tldr: Open-H-Embodiment is the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics, spanning over 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms, and it enables the first open vision-language-action model (GR00T-H) and the first action-conditioned world model (Cosmos-H) for multi-embodiment surgical simulation.
tldr_zh: Open-H-Embodiment是目前规模最大的开放医学机器人视频数据集，包含同步运动学数据，涵盖49余家机构和多种机器人平台，并支撑了首个开放的视觉-语言-动作模型GR00T-H以及首个动作条件的跨平台手术模拟世界模型Cosmos-H。

title: Divide-then-Diagnose: Weaving Clinician-Inspired Contexts for Ultra-Long Capsule Endoscopy Videos
summary: Capsule endoscopy (CE) enables non-invasive gastrointestinal screening, but current CE research remains largely limited to frame-level classification and detection, leaving video-level analysis underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce and formally define a new task, diagnosis-driven CE video summarization, which requires extracting key evidence frames that covers clinically meaningful findings and making accurate diagnoses from those evidence frames. This setting is challenging because diagnostically relevant events are extremely sparse and can be overwhelmed by tens of thousands of redundant normal frames, while individual observations are often ambiguous due to motion blur, debris, specular highlights, and rapid viewpoint changes. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce VideoCAP, the first CE dataset with diagnosis-driven annotations derived from real clinical reports. VideoCAP comprises 240 full-length videos and provides realistic supervision for both key evidence frame extraction and diagnosis. To address this task, we further propose DiCE, a clinician-inspired framework that mirrors the standard CE reading workflow. DiCE first performs efficient candidate screening over the raw video, then uses a Context Weaver to organize candidates into coherent diagnostic contexts that preserve distinct lesion events, and an Evidence Converger to aggregate multi-frame evidence within each context into robust clip-level judgments. Experiments show that DiCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, producing concise and clinically reliable diagnostic summaries. These results highlight diagnosis-driven contextual reasoning as a promising paradigm for ultra-long CE video summarization.
summary_zh: 胶囊内镜（CE）能够实现无创胃肠道筛查，但当前CE研究仍主要局限于帧级分类和检测，视频级分析仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们引入并正式定义了一个新任务——诊断驱动的CE视频摘要，该任务要求提取覆盖临床有意义发现的关键证据帧，并基于这些证据帧做出准确诊断。这一设置具有挑战性，因为诊断相关事件极为稀疏，可能被数以万计的冗余正常帧所淹没，而单个观察结果常因运动模糊、碎屑、镜面高光和快速视角变化而难以确定。为推动这一方向的研究，我们引入了VideoCAP，这是首个基于真实临床报告构建诊断驱动标注的CE数据集。VideoCAP包含240个完整视频，并为关键证据帧提取和诊断提供了真实监督。为解决这一任务，我们进一步提出了DiCE，一个临床启发的框架，遵循标准CE阅片工作流程。DiCE首先对原始视频进行高效候选筛选，然后使用上下文编织器将候选组织成连贯的诊断上下文以保留不同的病变事件，并使用证据聚合器在每个上下文内聚合多帧证据形成稳健的片段级判断。实验表明，DiCE始终优于最先进的方法，产生简洁且临床可靠的诊断摘要。这些结果凸显了诊断驱动的上下文推理作为超长CE视频摘要的一种有前景范式的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces a diagnosis-driven capsule endoscopy video summarization task, a new dataset (VideoCAP) with real clinical reports, and a clinician-inspired framework (DiCE) that extracts key evidence frames to produce accurate diagnostic summaries for ultra‑long CE videos.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了诊断驱动的胶囊内镜视频摘要任务，构建了首个带有真实临床报告标注的VideoCAP数据集，并设计了Divide‑then‑Diagnose（DiCE）框架，以从超长胶囊内镜视频中提取关键证据帧并给出准确诊断。

title: Sum-of-Checks: Structured Reasoning for Surgical Safety with Large Vision-Language Models
summary:
Purpose: Accurate assessment of the Critical View of Safety (CVS) during laparoscopic cholecystectomy is essential to prevent bile duct injury, a complication associated with significant morbidity and mortality. While large vision-language models (LVLMs) offer flexible reasoning, their predictions remain difficult to audit and unreliable on safety-critical surgical tasks.
  Methods: We introduce Sum-of-Checks, a framework that decomposes each CVS criterion into expert-defined reasoning checks reflecting clinically relevant visual evidence. Given a laparoscopic frame, an LVLM evaluates each check, producing a binary judgment and justification. Criterion-level scores are computed via fixed, weighted aggregation of check outcomes. We evaluate on the Endoscapes2023 benchmark using three frontier LVLMs, comparing against direct prompting, chain-of-thought, and sub-question decomposition, each with and without few-shot examples.
  Results: Sum-of-Checks improves average frame-level mean average precision by 12--14% relative to the best baseline across all three models and criteria. Analysis of individual checks reveals that LVLMs are reliable on observational checks (e.g., visibility, tool obstruction) but show substantial variability on decision-critical anatomical evidence.
  Conclusion: Structuring surgical reasoning into expert-aligned verification checks improves both accuracy and transparency of LVLM-based CVS assessment, demonstrating that explicitly separating evidence elicitation from decision-making is critical for reliable and auditable surgical AI systems.
  Code is available at https://github.com/BrachioLab/SumOfChecks.
summary_zh:
目的：在腹腔镜胆囊切除术中准确评估安全关键视图（CVS）对于预防胆管损伤至关重要，而胆管损伤是一种与高发病率和高死亡率相关的并发症。虽然大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）提供了灵活的推理能力，但其预测结果难以审计且在安全关键的外科任务中可靠性不足。

方法：我们提出了Sum-of-Checks框架，将每个CVS标准分解为反映临床相关视觉证据的专家定义推理检查。给定一帧腹腔镜图像，LVLM评估每个检查，生成二元判断和理由。标准级分数通过检查结果的固定加权聚合计算得出。我们在Endoscapes2023基准数据集上使用三个前沿LVLM进行评估，与直接提示、思维链和子问题分解进行比较，每种方法均分别测试有无少样本示例。

结果：Sum-of-Checks将平均帧级平均精度相较于所有三个模型和标准上的最佳基线方法提高了12%至14%。对单个检查的分析表明，LVLM在观察性检查（如可见性、器械遮挡）上表现可靠，但在决策关键解剖学证据上表现出显著变异性。

结论：将外科推理结构化为专家对齐的验证检查可提高基于LVLM的CVS评估的准确性和透明度，证明将证据获取与决策明确分离对于可靠且可审计的外科AI系统至关重要。

代码可访问：https://github.com/BrachioLab/SumOfChecks

title: Real-Time Non-Contact Force Compensation for Wrist-Mounted Force/Torque Sensors in Haptic-Enabled Robotic Surgery Training
summary: Haptic feedback has been a long-missed feature in robotic-assisted surgery, one that would allow surgeons to perceive tissue properties and apply controlled forces during delicate procedures. Although commercial robotic systems have begun to integrate haptic technologies, their high costs limit accessibility for training and research purposes. To address this gap, we extend our previously developed low-cost robotic surgery training setup, RoboScope, by incorporating a wrist-mounted force/torque (F/T) sensor for haptic feedback training. Wrist-mounted sensing avoids many challenges associated with tip-mounted sensors but introduces additional non-contact forces, such as gravity, sensor bias, installation offsets, and associated torques, which compromise measurement accuracy. In this paper, we propose a robust real-time compensation method based on recursive least squares (RLS). This method eliminates the need for dataset collection and frequent recalibration while adapting to changing operating conditions. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves over 95% error reduction in non-contact force compensation and more than 91% in non-contact torque compensation, significantly outperforming existing methods. These results highlight the potential of our approach for providing reliable haptic feedback in robotic surgery training and research.
summary_zh:
摘要：
触觉反馈一直是机器人辅助手术中缺失已久的功能，它使外科医生能够在精细手术过程中感知组织特性并施加可控力。尽管商业机器人系统已开始整合触觉技术，但其高昂的成本限制了培训和研究目的的可及性。为解决这一差距，我们扩展了先前开发的低成本机器人手术训练平台RoboScope，集成了一种腕戴式力/力矩（F/T）传感器用于触觉反馈训练。腕戴式传感避免了与尖端安装式传感器相关的许多挑战，但引入了额外的非接触力，如重力、传感器偏置、安装偏移及相关力矩，这些因素会影响测量精度。本文提出了一种基于递推最小二乘（RLS）的鲁棒实时补偿方法。该方法无需数据集采集和频繁重新校准，同时能够适应不断变化的工作条件。实验验证表明，所提出的方法在非接触力补偿方面实现了超过95%的误差减少，在非接触力矩补偿方面实现了超过91%的误差减少，显著优于现有方法。这些结果凸显了我们的方法在机器人手术培训和研究中提供可靠触觉反馈的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces a real‑time recursive‑least‑squares method to compensate non‑contact forces and torques in wrist‑mounted force/torque sensors for a low‑cost haptic‑enabled robotic surgery training platform, achieving over 95% error reduction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于递归最小二乘的实时补偿方法，用于消除腕装力/扭矩传感器在低成本 haptic 手术训练系统中的非接触力和扭矩误差，实现95%以上的误差降低。

title: Reference-Augmented Learning for Precise Tracking Policy of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots (TDCRs) pose significant control challenges due to their highly nonlinear, path-dependent dynamics and non-Markovian characteristics. Traditional Jacobian-based controllers often struggle with hysteresis-induced oscillations, while conventional learning-based approaches suffer from poor generalization to out-of-distribution trajectories. This paper proposes a reference-augmented offline learning framework for precise 6-DOF tracking control of TDCRs. By leveraging a differentiable RNN-based dynamics surrogate as a gradient bridge, we optimize a control policy through an augmented reference distribution. This multi-scale augmentation scheme incorporates stochastic bias, harmonic perturbations, and random walks, forcing the policy to internalize diverse tracking error recovery mechanisms without additional hardware interaction. Experimental results on a three-section TDCR platform demonstrate that the proposed policy achieves a 50.9\% reduction in average position error compared to non-augmented baselines and significantly outperforms Jacobian-based methods in both precision and stability across various speeds.
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs）由于其高度非线性的、路径依赖的动力学特性以及非马尔可夫特性，带来了重大的控制挑战。传统基于雅可比矩阵的控制器通常难以应对滞后引起的振荡问题，而传统的基于学习的方法在推广到分布外轨迹时表现较差。本文提出了一种参考增强离线学习框架，用于实现TDCRs的精确6自由度跟踪控制。通过利用可微循环神经网络（RNN）动力学代理模型作为梯度桥，我们通过增强参考分布来优化控制策略。这种多尺度增强方案结合了随机偏置、谐波扰动和随机游走，迫使策略内化多种跟踪误差恢复机制，而无需额外的硬件交互。在三段式TDCR平台上的实验结果表明，与非增强基线相比，所提出的策略将平均位置误差降低了50.9%，并在各种速度下在精度和稳定性方面均显著优于基于雅可比矩阵的方法。
tldr: This paper proposes a reference‑augmented offline learning framework for precise 6‑DOF tracking of tendon‑driven continuum robots, employing a differentiable RNN‑based dynamics surrogate and multi‑scale augmentation (stochastic bias, harmonic perturbations, random walks). Experiments demonstrate a 50.9% reduction in average position error versus non‑augmented baselines and superior performance over Jacobian‑based controllers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种参考增强的离线学习框架，用于实现腱驱动连续体机器人的6自由度精确跟踪。该方法利用可微分的RNN动力学代理模型和多尺度增强（随机偏置、谐波扰动、随机游走），实验表明平均位置误差比基线降低50.9%，且在精度和稳定性上优于雅可比控制器。

title: Learning-Based Dynamics Modeling and Robust Control for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots (TDCRs) pose significant modeling and control challenges due to complex nonlinearities, such as frictional hysteresis and transmission compliance. This paper proposes a differentiable learning framework that integrates high-fidelity dynamics modeling with robust neural control. We develop a GRU-based dynamics model featuring bidirectional multi-channel connectivity and residual prediction to effectively suppress compounding errors during long-horizon auto-regressive prediction. By treating this model as a gradient bridge, an end-to-end neural control policy is optimized through backpropagation, allowing it to implicitly internalize compensation for intricate nonlinearities. Experimental validation on a physical three-section TDCR demonstrates that our framework achieves accurate tracking and superior robustness against unseen payloads, outperforming Jacobian-based methods by eliminating self-excited oscillations.
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs）由于复杂的非线性特性（如摩擦滞后和传动柔顺性），在建模与控制方面面临重大挑战。本文提出了一种可微学习框架，将高保真动力学建模与鲁棒神经控制相结合。我们开发了一种基于GRU的动力学模型，采用双向多通道连接和残差预测技术，以有效抑制长时域自回归预测过程中的累积误差。通过将该模型作为梯度桥接器，利用反向传播优化端到端神经控制策略，使其能够隐式内化对复杂非线性特性的补偿能力。在物理三段式TDCR上的实验验证表明，我们的框架实现了精确跟踪，并对未知负载展现出卓越的鲁棒性，优于基于雅可比矩阵的方法，消除了自激振荡现象。
tldr: This paper introduces a differentiable learning framework that combines a GRU‑based dynamics model with residual prediction and an end‑to‑end neural control policy to address the nonlinear modeling and control challenges of tendon‑driven continuum robots, demonstrating accurate tracking and robust performance against unseen payloads on a physical three‑section TDCR.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种可微分的学习框架，将基于GRU的高保真动力学模型与残差预测及端到端神经控制策略相结合，以解决腱驱动连续体机器人的非线性建模与控制难题，并在三段式TDCR上展示了精确跟踪和對未知负载的强鲁棒性。

title: SAMe: A Semantic Anatomy Mapping Engine for Robotic Ultrasound
summary: Robotic ultrasound has advanced local image-driven control, contact regulation, and view optimization, yet current systems lack the anatomical understanding needed to determine what to scan, where to begin, and how to adapt to individual patient anatomy. These gaps make systems still reliant on expert intervention to initiate scanning. Here we present SAMe, a semantic anatomy mapping engine that provides robotic ultrasound with an explicit anatomical prior layer. SAMe addresses scan initiation as a target-to-anatomy-to-action process: it grounds under-specified clinical complaints into structured target organs, instantiates a patient-specific anatomical representation for the grounded targets from a single external body image, and translates this representation into control-facing 6-DoF probe initialization states without any additional registration using preoperative CT or MRI. The anatomical representation maintained by SAMe is explicit, lightweight (single-organ inference in 0.08s), and compatible with downstream control by design. Across semantic grounding, anatomical instantiation, and real-robot evaluation, SAMe shows strong performance across the full initialization pipeline. In real-robot experiments, SAMe achieved overall organ-hit rates of 97.3% for liver initialization and 81.7% for kidney initialization across the evaluated target sets. Even when restricted to the centroid target, SAMe outperformed the surface-heuristic baseline for both liver and kidney initialization. These results establish an explicit anatomical prior layer that addresses scan initialization and is designed to support broader downstream autonomous scanning pipelines, providing the anatomical foundation for complaint-driven, anatomically informed robotic ultrasonography.
summary_zh: 机器人超声技术在局部图像驱动控制、接触调节和视图优化方面取得了进展，然而当前系统仍缺乏必要的解剖学理解，无法确定扫描内容、起始位置以及如何适应个体患者解剖结构。这些差距使得系统仍然依赖专家干预来启动扫描。在此，我们提出SAMe，一种为机器人超声提供显式解剖先验层的语义解剖映射引擎。SAMe将扫描初始化作为一个目标-解剖-动作过程来处理：它将未明确指定的临床主诉锚定到结构化目标器官，从单张外部本体图像为锚定的目标实例化患者特异性解剖表示，并将该表示转换为面向控制的6自由度探头初始化状态，无需使用术前CT或MRI进行任何额外配准。SAMe维护的解剖表示具有显式、轻量级（单器官推理仅需0.08秒）的特点，并从设计上兼容下游控制。在语义锚定、解剖实例化和真实机器人评估中，SAMe在整个初始化流程中表现出色。在真实机器人实验中，SAMe在肝脏初始化中达到了97.3%的总体器官命中率，在肾脏初始化中达到了81.7%的总体器官命中率，跨越了所有评估的目标点。即使仅限于质心目标，SAMe在肝脏和肾脏初始化方面的表现也优于表面启发式基准。这些结果确立了一个显式解剖先验层，该先验层解决了扫描初始化问题，并旨在支持更广泛的下游自主扫描流程，为主诉驱动、解剖信息引导的机器人超声检查提供了解剖学基础。
tldr: The paper introduces SAMe, a semantic anatomy mapping engine that infers patient‑specific organ locations from a single external body image to generate 6‑DoF probe initialization states for robotic ultrasound, achieving 97.3% liver and 81.7% kidney hit rates in real‑robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SAMe，一种语义解剖映射引擎，通过单张外部人体图像推断患者特定的器官位置，生成机器人超声探头的6自由度初始化状态，在实际机器人实验中实现了肝脏97.3%和肾脏81.7%的命中率。

title: Image Compression with Bubble-Aware Frame Rate Adaptation for Energy-Efficient Video Capsule Endoscopy
summary: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) is a promising method for improving the medical examination of the small intestine in the gastrointestinal tract. A key challenge is their limited size, resulting in a short battery lifetime which conflicts with high energy consumption for image capturing and transmission to an on-body device. Thus, we propose an image compression pipeline that substantially reduces the transmitted data while preserving diagnostic image quality. Furthermore, we exploit characteristics of the compression process to identify frames with low diagnostic value mainly caused by bubbles, without requiring additional image analysis. For low-visibility frames, a dynamic bubble-aware frame rate adaptation strategy reduces image acquisition and transmission during these phases while preserving sensitivity to potential anomalies. The proposed compression and frame rate adaptation are evaluated on a RISC-V platform using the Kvasir-Capsule and Galar datasets. The compression method achieves a compression ratio of 5.748 (82.6%) at a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 40.3 dB, indicating negligible loss of visual quality. The compression accomplished a mean energy reduction of the whole system by 20.58%. Additionally, the proposed bubble-aware frame rate adaptation reduced the energy consumption by up to 40%. These results demonstrate the potential of our method to increase the applicability of VCE.
summary_zh: 视频胶囊内镜（VCE）是一种有望改善胃肠道小肠医学检查的方法。其中的一个关键挑战在于其尺寸受限，导致电池续航时间短，而这与图像采集和向体表设备传输的高能耗之间存在矛盾。因此，我们提出了一种图像压缩流程，该流程在保持诊断图像质量的同时大幅减少传输数据量。此外，我们利用压缩过程的特性来识别诊断价值较低的帧，这些帧主要由气泡引起，无需额外的图像分析即可实现。对于低能见度帧，我们采用动态气泡感知帧率自适应策略，在这些阶段减少图像采集和传输，同时保持对潜在异常的敏感性。我们在RISC-V平台上使用Kvasir-Capsule和Galar数据集对所提出的压缩和帧率自适应方法进行了评估。压缩方法在峰值信噪比为40.3 dB时达到了5.748的压缩比（82.6%），表明视觉质量损失可忽略不计。压缩使整个系统的平均能耗降低了20.58%。此外，所提出的气泡感知帧率自适应将能耗降低了高达40%。这些结果表明，我们的方法有望提高VCE的适用性。
tldr: The paper proposes an image‑compression pipeline that exploits compression characteristics to detect low‑diagnostic‑value frames (mainly bubbles) and applies a dynamic bubble‑aware frame‑rate adaptation, achieving a 5.7× compression ratio and up to 40% energy reduction for video capsule endoscopy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种利用压缩特征识别低诊断价值帧（主要是气泡）并实现动态气泡感知的帧率适配的图像压缩方案，在视频胶囊内镜中实现了约5.7倍的压缩比和最高40%的能耗降低。

title: Stochastic Entanglement of Deterministic Origami Tentacles For Universal Robotic Gripping
summary: Origami-inspired robotic grippers have shown promising potential for object manipulation tasks due to their compact volume and mechanical flexibility. However, robust capture of objects with random shapes in dynamic working environments often comes at the cost of additional actuation channels and control complexity. Here, we introduce a tendon-driven origami tentacle gripper capable of universal object gripping by exploiting a synergy between local, deterministic deformation programming and global, stochastic entanglements. Each origami tentacle is made by cutting thin Mylar sheets; It features carefully placed holes for routing an actuation tendon, origami creases for controlling the deformation, and a tapered shape. By tailoring these design features, one can prescribe the shrinking, bending, and twisting deformation, eventually creating deterministic coiling with a simple tendon pull. Then, when multiple coiling tentacles are placed in proximity, stochastic entanglement emerges, allowing the tentacles to braid, knot, and grip objects with random shapes. We derived a simulation model by integrating origami mechanics with Cosserat rods to correlate origami design, tendon deformation, and their collective gripping performance. Then, we experimentally tested how these coiling and entangling origami tentacles can grasp objects under gravity and in water. A stow-and-release deployment mechanism was also tested to simulate in-orbit grasping. Overall, the entertaining origami tentacle gripper presents a new strategy for robust object grasping with simple design and actuation.
summary_zh:
摘要：

折纸启发的机器人夹爪因其紧凑的体积和机械柔顺性，在物体操控任务中展现出良好的应用前景。然而，在动态工作环境中稳健抓取随机形状的物体通常以增加驱动通道和控制复杂度为代价。本文提出了一种肌腱驱动的折纸触手夹爪，能够通过利用局部确定性变形编程与全局随机缠结之间的协同作用，实现对任意物体的抓取。每个折纸触手由薄层聚酯薄膜切割制成，其特征包括：用于穿设驱动肌腱的精心布置的孔、用于控制变形的折纸折痕以及锥形结构。通过定制这些设计特征，可以预设收缩、弯曲和扭转变形，最终通过简单的肌腱牵引实现确定性卷曲。随后，当多个卷曲触手放置在近距离时，随机缠结现象自然产生，使触手能够编织、打结并抓取任意形状的物体。我们通过将折纸力学与Cosserat杆理论相结合构建了仿真模型，以关联折纸设计、肌腱变形及其集合抓取性能。随后，我们实验测试了这些卷曲和缠结折纸触手在重力和水下的抓取能力。我们还测试了一种收纳-释放部署机制，以模拟轨道抓取。总体而言，这种有趣的折纸触手夹爪为通过简单设计和驱动实现稳健物体抓取提供了一种新策略。

title: DepthPilot: From Controllability to Interpretability in Colonoscopy Video Generation
summary: Controllable medical video generation has achieved remarkable progress, but it still lacks interpretability, which requires the alignment of generated contents with physical priors and faithful clinical manifestations. To push the boundaries from mere controllability to interpretability, we propose DepthPilot, the first interpretable framework for colonoscopy video generation. This work takes a step toward trustworthy generation through two synergistic paradigms. To achieve explicit geometric grounding, DepthPilot devises a prior distribution alignment strategy, injecting depth constraints into the diffusion backbone via parameter-efficient fine-tuning to ensure anatomical fidelity. To enhance intrinsic nonlinear modeling under these geometric constraints, DepthPilot employs an adaptive spline denoising module, replacing fixed linear weights with learnable spline functions to capture complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Extensive evaluations across three public datasets and in-house clinical data confirm DepthPilot's robust ability to produce physically consistent videos. It achieves FID scores below 15 across all benchmarks and ranks first in clinician assessments, bridging the gap between "visually realistic" and "clinically interpretable". Moreover, DepthPilot-generated videos are expected to enable reliable 3D reconstruction, facilitating surgical navigation and blind region identification, and serve as a foundation toward the colorectal world model.
summary_zh: 可控医学视频生成已取得显著进展，但仍缺乏可解释性，这要求生成内容与物理先验和真实临床表征相一致。为了推动从单纯可控性向可解释性的跨越，我们提出了DepthPilot，这是首个用于结肠镜视频生成的可解释框架。该工作通过两个协同范式向可信生成迈出了第一步。为实现明确的几何锚定，DepthPilot设计了一种先验分布对齐策略，通过参数高效微调将深度约束注入扩散主干，以确保解剖保真度。为在这些几何约束下增强内在非线性建模能力，DepthPilot采用自适应样条去噪模块，用可学习的样条函数替换固定的线性权重，以捕捉复杂的时空动力学。三个公共数据集和内部临床数据的广泛评估证实了DepthPilot生成物理一致视频的鲁棒能力。其在所有基准测试中均实现了低于15的FID分数，并在临床医生评估中排名第一，弥合了"视觉逼真"与"临床可解释"之间的鸿沟。此外，DepthPilot生成的视频有望实现可靠的3D重建，支持手术导航和盲区识别，并作为结直肠世界模型的基础。
tldr: DepthPilot introduces an interpretable colonoscopy video generation framework that aligns depth priors with diffusion models and uses adaptive spline denoising to produce anatomically faithful, clinically interpretable videos.
tldr_zh: DepthPilot提出了一个可解释的结肠镜视频生成框架，通过在扩散模型中对齐深度先验并采用自适应样条去噪，生成解剖学上可信且临床可解释的视频。

title: Stop Holding Your Breath: CT-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Bronchoscopy
summary: Bronchoscopic navigation relies on registering endoscopic video to a preoperative CT scan, but respiratory motion deforms the airway by 5-20 mm, creating CT-to-body divergence that limits localization accuracy. In practice, this is mitigated through breath-hold protocols, which attempt to match the intraoperative anatomy to a static CT, but are difficult to reproduce and disrupt clinical workflow. We propose to eliminate the need for breath-hold protocols by leveraging patient-specific respiratory modeling. Paired inhale-exhale CT scans, already acquired for planning, implicitly define the patient-specific deformation space of the breathing airway. By registering these scans, we reduce respiratory motion to a single scalar breathing phase per frame, constraining all reconstructions to anatomically observed configurations. We embed this representation within a mesh-anchored Gaussian splatting framework, where a lightweight estimator infers breathing phase directly from endoscopic RGB, enabling continuous, deformation-aware reconstruction throughout the respiratory cycle without breath-holds or external sensing. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce RESPIRE, a physically grounded bronchoscopy simulation pipeline with per-frame ground truth for geometry, pose, breathing phase, and deformation. Experiments on RESPIRE show that our approach achieves geometrically faithful reconstruction, over 20x faster training, and 1.22 mm target localization accuracy (within the 3mm clinically relevant tolerances) outperforming unconstrained single-CT baselines. Please check out our website for additional visuals: https://asdunnbe.github.io/RESPIRE/
summary_zh: 支气管镜导航依赖于将内镜视频配准至术前CT扫描，但呼吸运动会使气道发生5-20 mm的变形，产生CT到身体的差异，从而限制定位精度。在临床实践中，通常通过屏气协议来缓解这一问题，试图将术中解剖结构与静态CT相匹配，但这种协议难以重现且会扰乱临床工作流程。我们提出利用患者特异性呼吸建模来消除对屏气协议的需求。规划阶段已获取的成对吸气和呼气CT扫描隐式定义了患者呼吸气道的变形空间。通过对这些扫描进行配准，我们将呼吸运动简化为每帧的单一标量呼吸相位，将所有重建约束到解剖学可观察的配置。我们将这一表示嵌入到网格锚定的高斯溅射框架中，其中一个轻量级估计器可直接从内镜RGB图像推断呼吸相位，从而在整个呼吸周期内实现连续、变形感知的重建，无需屏气或外部传感。为实现定量评估，我们引入了RESPIRE，这是一个物理基础的支气管镜模拟管道，提供每帧的几何、姿态、呼吸相位和变形的真值。在RESPIRE上的实验表明，我们的方法实现了几何保真的重建，训练速度提升超过20倍，目标定位精度达到1.22 mm（处于3 mm临床相关容差范围内），优于无约束单CT基线方法。请访问我们的网站获取更多可视化内容：https://asdunnbe.github.io/RESPIRE/

title: A Model-based Visual Contact Localization and Force Sensing System for Compliant Robotic Grippers
summary: Grasp force estimation can help prevent robots from damaging delicate objects during manipulation and improve learning-based robotic control. Integrating force sensing into deformable grippers negotiates trade-offs in cost, complexity, mechanical robustness, and performance. With the growing integration of RGB-D wrist cameras into robotic systems for control purposes, camera-based techniques are a promising solution for indirect visual force estimation. Current approaches mostly utilize end-to-end deep learning, which can be brittle when generalizing to new scenarios, while existing model-based approaches are unsuited to grasping and modern grasper geometries. To address these challenges, we developed a model-based visual force sensing approach integrating an iterative contact localization with generalization to unseen objects. The system extracts structural key points from wrist camera RGB-D images of deforming fin-ray-shaped soft grippers, and uses these key points to define parameters of an inverse finite element analysis simulation in Simulation Open Framework Architecture. The iterative contact localization sub-system utilizes a deep learning-based online 3D reconstruction and pose estimation pipeline to dynamically update contact location, and is robust to visual occlusion and unseen objects. Our system demonstrated an average root mean square error of 0.23 N and normalized root mean square deviation of 2.11% during the load phase, and 0.48 N and 4.34% over the entire grasping process when interacting with different objects under various conditions, showcasing its potential for real-time model-based indirect force sensing of soft grippers.
summary_zh:
摘要：
抓取力估计可以帮助防止机器人在操作过程中损坏精细物体，并改进基于学习的机器人控制。将力传感集成到可变形夹爪中可以权衡成本、复杂度、机械鲁棒性和性能。随着RGB-D腕部相机越来越多地集成到用于控制的机器人系统中，基于相机的技术是间接视觉力估计的一种有前景的解决方案。当前的方法主要使用端到端深度学习，这在泛化到新场景时可能很脆弱，而现有的基于模型的方法不适用于抓取和现代夹爪几何形状。为了应对这些挑战，我们开发了一种基于模型的视觉力感知方法，将迭代接触定位与对未见过物体的泛化相结合。该系统从变形鳍射线形软夹爪的腕部相机RGB-D图像中提取结构关键点，并使用这些关键点来定义Simulation Open Framework Architecture中逆有限元分析仿真的参数。迭代接触定位子系统利用基于深度学习的在线三维重建和位姿估计管道来动态更新接触位置，并对视觉遮挡和未见过物体具有鲁棒性。我们的系统在加载阶段的平均均方根误差为0.23 N，归一化均方根偏差为2.11%，在整个抓取过程中为0.48 N和4.34%，在不同条件下与不同物体交互时表现出色，展示了其用于软夹爪实时基于模型的间接力传感的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces a model‑based visual force‑sensing system for compliant robotic grippers that uses key points extracted from wrist‑camera RGB‑D images to drive an inverse FEM simulation, achieving low force estimation error across varied objects.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于模型的视觉力传感方法，利用腕部相机获取的RGB‑D图像关键点驱动逆有限元分析，从而实现对柔性夹爪的接触定位与力估计，并在多种物体上取得了较高的测量精度。

title: Multi-frame Restoration for High-rate Lissajous Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy
summary: Lissajous confocal laser endomicroscopy (CLE) is a promising solution for high speed in vivo optical biopsy for handheld scenarios. However, Lissajous scanning traces a resonant trajectory and samples only the visited pixels per frame; at high frame rates, many pixels remain unvisited, creating structured holes. In this work, we introduce the first benchmark for high-rate Lissajous CLE, consisting of low-quality video clips paired with high-quality reference images. The reference images are wide-FOV mosaics obtained by stitching stabilized, slow-scan frames of the same tissue, enabling temporally aligned supervision. Using this dataset, we propose MIRA, a lightweight recurrent framework for Lissajous CLE restoration that iteratively aggregates temporal context through feature reuse and displacement alignment. Our experiments demonstrate that MIRA outperforms both lightweight and high-complexity baselines in restoration quality while maintaining a favorable computational efficiency suitable for clinical deployment.
summary_zh: Lissajous共聚焦激光内镜显微镜(CLE)是一种有望实现手持场景下高速活体光学活检的解决方案。然而，Lissajous扫描呈现共振轨迹，每帧仅对访问过的像素进行采样；在高帧率下，许多像素未被访问，形成结构化缺失。本研究提出了首个高帧率Lissajous CLE基准数据集，由低质量视频片段与高质量参考图像配对组成。参考图像为通过对同一组织进行稳定慢速扫描并拼接而获得的宽视野马赛克图像，实现了时间对齐的监督。利用该数据集，本研究提出了MIRA——一个用于Lissajous CLE图像重建的轻量级循环框架，通过特征复用和位移对齐迭代聚合时间上下文信息。实验表明，MIRA在重建质量上优于轻量级和高复杂度基线方法，同时保持适合临床部署的计算效率。
tldr: A new benchmark dataset and a lightweight recurrent network (MIRA) to restore high-rate Lissajous confocal laser endomicroscopy images by aggregating temporal context.
tldr_zh: 提出首个高帧率Lissajous共聚焦激光内窥镜成像的基准数据集，并设计轻量级循环网络MIRA，通过时间上下文聚合实现图像修复。

title: Quasi-Static Control of Discrete Cosserat Rod
summary: In this paper, we design feedback control laws for soft robots modelled using the Cosserat rod, which is spatially discretised using the Piecewise Constant Strain (PCS) approach. The PCS approach transforms the nonlinear PDEs describing the Cosserat rod to a system of nonlinear ODEs. This simplification results in a model describing soft robots which is similar to the serial rigid-link manipulators. We design feedback control laws for the quasi-static PCS model by using the external end-effector wrench as control input. The control laws are designed based on state-feedback linearisation in strain and task spaces. An extensive set of numerical results demonstrates the performance of the control laws for end-effector trajectory tracking and shape control of soft robots.
summary_zh: 本文针对采用Cosserat杆模型建模的软体机器人设计了反馈控制律，该模型采用分段常应变（PCS）方法进行空间离散化。PCS方法将描述Cosserat杆的非线性偏微分方程转化为非线性常微分方程系统。这种简化使得软体机器人的模型类似于串联刚体机械臂。我们以末端执行器广义力作为控制输入，为准静态PCS模型设计反馈控制律。该控制律基于应变空间和任务空间的状态反馈线性化设计。大量数值结果表明了该控制律在软体机器人末端执行器轨迹跟踪和形状控制方面的性能。
tldr: The paper develops quasi‑static feedback control laws for soft robots modeled as discrete Cosserat rods using the Piecewise Constant Strain (PCS) method, employing end‑effector wrenches as inputs to achieve trajectory tracking and shape control.
tldr_zh: 本文基于分段常应变（PCS）方法建立了软体机器人离散Cosserat杆的准静态反馈控制律，以末端执行器 wrench 为输入实现轨迹跟踪和形状控制。

title: Shared Autonomy Assisted by Impedance-Driven Anisotropic Guidance Field
summary: Shared autonomy (SA) enables robots to infer human intent and assist in its achievement. While most research focuses on improving intent inference, it overlooks whether humans can understand the robot's intent in return. Without such mutual understanding, collaboration becomes less effective, degrading user experience and task performance. To address this gap, previous studies have explicitly conveyed the robot intent through additional interfaces, which remain unintuitive and limited in expressiveness. Inspired by impedance control, we propose Impedance-Driven Anisotropic Guidance Field Enhanced Shared Autonomy (IAGF-SA), a novel paradigm that extends SA with an embodied, physically-grounded communication channel. This channel adaptively modulates the robot's dynamic response to human input, enabling intuitive, continuous, physically-grounded robot intent communication while naturally guiding human actions. User studies across three scenarios and two teleoperation interfaces indicate that IAGF-SA improves task performance, human-robot agreement, and subjective experience, thus demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing human-robot communication and collaboration.
summary_zh: 共享自主性（SA）使机器人能够推断人类意图并协助实现目标。现有研究大多聚焦于提升意图推断能力，却忽视了人类能否同步理解机器人意图的问题。缺乏这种双向理解会削弱协作效率，降低用户体验与任务执行效果。针对这一局限，先前研究主要通过附加接口显式传递机器人意图，但此类方式仍不够直观且表达能力有限。受阻抗控制启发，我们提出一种阻抗驱动的各向异性导引场增强型共享自主性（IAGF-SA）新范式。该范式通过具身化、物理基础的通信通道扩展了传统SA框架，能自适应调节机器人对人类输入的动态响应，在自然引导人类操作的同时，实现直观、连续、基于物理机制的机器人意图传递。在三种场景与两种遥操作接口下的用户研究表明，IAGF-SA能有效提升任务执行效率、人机协同一致性及主观体验，从而验证了其增强人机通信与协作能力的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes IAGF-SA, a shared autonomy method that uses impedance control to create a physical guidance field, allowing the robot to intuitively convey its intent back to the human operator while assisting them, thereby improving mutual understanding and collaboration in teleoperation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了IAGF-SA，一种共享自治方法，它利用阻抗控制生成物理引导场，使机器人能够直观地向人类操作员传达其意图并进行辅助，从而提升遥操作任务中的相互理解与协作效果。

title: Semantic Risk-Aware Heuristic Planning for Robotic Navigation in Dynamic Environments: An LLM-Inspired Approach
summary: The integration of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning principles into classical robot path planning represents a rapidly emerging research direction. In this paper, we propose a Semantic Risk-Aware Heuristic (SRAH) planner that encodes LLM-inspired cost functions penalising geometrically cluttered or high-risk zones into an A$^*$ search framework, augmented with closed-loop replanning upon dynamic obstacle detection. We evaluate SRAH against two established baselines Breadth-First Search (BFS) with replanning and a Greedy heuristic without replanning across 200 randomised trials in a $15{\times}15$ grid-world with 20\% static obstacle density and stochastic dynamic obstacles. SRAH achieves a task success rate of 62.0\%, outperforming BFS (56.5\%) by 9.7\% relative improvement and Greedy (4.0\%) by a large margin. We further analyse the trade-off between planning overhead, path efficiency, and failure-recovery count, and demonstrate via an obstacle-density ablation that semantic cost shaping consistently improves navigation across environments of varying difficulty. Our results suggest that even lightweight, LLM-inspired heuristics provide measurable safety and robustness gains for autonomous robot navigation.
summary_zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）的推理机制融入经典机器人路径规划，已成为一个快速兴起的研究方向。本文提出了一种语义风险感知启发式（SRAH）规划器，该规划器将受LLM启发的成本函数编码至A*搜索框架中，对几何结构杂乱或高风险区域施加惩罚，并引入动态障碍物检测后的闭环重规划机制。我们在一个15×15网格世界（静态障碍物密度20%且存在随机动态障碍）中进行了200次随机试验，将SRAH与两种现有基线方法——带重规划的广度优先搜索（BFS）以及不带重规划的贪心启发式算法——进行对比评估。SRAH的任务成功率达到62.0%，相对于BFS（56.5%）实现了9.7%的相对提升，并显著优于贪心算法（4.0%）。我们进一步分析了规划开销、路径效率与故障恢复次数之间的权衡关系，并通过障碍物密度消融实验证明：语义成本塑形能持续提升算法在不同难度环境中的导航性能。实验结果表明，即使是轻量级的、受LLM启发的启发式方法，也能为自主机器人导航带来可量化的安全性与鲁棒性提升。
tldr: The paper introduces a Semantic Risk-Aware Heuristic (SRAH) planner for robot navigation, which integrates LLM-inspired cost functions into an A* search framework to penalize cluttered or high-risk zones. It demonstrates improved success rates over classical baselines in a grid-world with dynamic obstacles, suggesting lightweight LLM-inspired heuristics can enhance safety and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人导航的语义风险感知启发式（SRAH）规划器，将受大语言模型（LLM）启发的成本函数集成到A*搜索框架中，以惩罚几何上杂乱或高风险的区域。在包含动态障碍物的网格世界实验中，它相比经典基线方法展示了更高的任务成功率，表明轻量级的LLM启发式方法可以增强自主导航的安全性和鲁棒性。

title: SymptomAI: Towards a Conversational AI Agent for Everyday Symptom Assessment
summary: Language models excel at diagnostic assessments on currated medical case-studies and vignettes, performing on par with, or better than, clinical professionals. However, existing studies focus on complex scenarios with rich context making it difficult to draw conclusions about how these systems perform for patients reporting symptoms in everyday life. We deployed SymptomAI, a set of conversational AI agents for end-to-end patient interviewing and differential diagnosis (DDx), via the Fitbit app in a study that randomized participants (N=13,917) to interact with five AI agents. This corpus captures diverse communication and a realistic distribution of illnesses from a real world population. A subset of 1,228 participants reported a clinician-provided diagnosis, and 517 of these were further evaluated by a panel of clinicians during over 250 hours of annotation. SymptomAI DDx were significantly more accurate (OR = 2.47, p < 0.001) than those from independent clinicians given the same dialogue in a blinded randomized comparison. Moreover, agentic strategies which conduct a dedicated symptom interview that elicit additional symptom information before providing a diagnosis, perform substantially better than baseline, user-guided conversations (p < 0.001). An auxiliary analysis on 1,509 conversations from a general US population panel validated that these results generalize beyond wearable device users. We used SymptomAI diagnoses as labels for all 13,917 participants to analyze over 500,000 days of wearable metrics across nearly 400 unique conditions. We identified strong associations between acute infections and physiological shifts (e.g., OR > 7 for influenza). While limited by self-reported ground truth, these results demonstrate the benefits of a dedicated and complete symptom interview compared to a user-guided symptom discussion, which is the default of most consumer LLMs.
summary_zh: 语言模型在精心设计的医学案例研究和小型病例评估中表现出色，其诊断能力与临床专业人员相当甚至更优。然而，现有研究多聚焦于背景信息丰富的复杂场景，难以据此推断这些系统在患者日常症状报告中的表现。我们通过Fitbit应用程序部署了SymptomAI系统——一套用于端到端患者问诊与鉴别诊断的对话式AI代理，在一项纳入13,917名参与者的随机研究中，安排其与五种AI代理进行交互。该语料库捕捉了真实人群的多样化沟通方式和疾病分布特征。在1,228名获得临床医生诊断的参与者子集中，有517例经过临床专家小组超过250小时的标注评估。在盲法随机对照实验中，基于相同对话记录，SymptomAI的鉴别诊断准确率显著高于独立临床医生（OR = 2.47，p < 0.001）。此外，采用主动症状访谈策略（即在诊断前收集额外症状信息）的AI代理，其表现显著优于用户引导式对话的基线策略（p < 0.001）。对1,509例美国普通人群对话的辅助分析验证了该结果在可穿戴设备用户群体外的普适性。我们将SymptomAI的诊断结果作为13,917名参与者的标注数据，分析了涵盖近400种独特病症的超过50万日可穿戴设备指标。研究发现急性感染与生理指标变化存在强关联（如流感OR值>7）。尽管受限于自我报告的真实诊断数据，这些结果证明：相较于当前大多数消费级大语言模型默认采用的用户引导式症状讨论，完整且专业的症状主动访谈具有显著优势。
tldr: This paper presents SymptomAI, a conversational AI agent for symptom assessment deployed via the Fitbit app. In a large-scale real-world study, the AI's diagnostic accuracy was significantly better than independent clinicians, and its structured interview strategy outperformed user-guided conversations, demonstrating the value of a dedicated symptom interview.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SymptomAI，一种通过Fitbit应用程序部署的用于症状评估的对话式AI智能体。在一项大规模现实世界研究中，该AI的诊断准确性显著优于独立临床医生，其结构化访谈策略也优于用户引导的对话，证明了专用症状访谈的价值。

title: Autonomous Laparoscope Control through Unified Mechanics-Based Representation of Multimodal Intraoperative Information
summary: Laparoscope-holding robots can provide surgeons with a stable laparoscopic field of view (FOV) and reduce the burden on human assistants. To maintain an ideal intraoperative FOV, the robot must continuously adjust the laparoscope pose according to intraoperative information. However, intraoperative multimodal signals, such as position, force/torque, and images, differ markedly in physical meaning and units, making it difficult to build a unified representation and to generate control commands that can be used directly for laparoscope control. To address this issue, we propose a laparoscope-holding robot control method based on unified mechanics modeling of multimodal information. First, we design mapping strategies for multiple intraoperative sources, including position, force/torque, and images, and unify them into an equivalent-wrench representation in the operational space. Then, using a task-priority scheme, we inject the wrenches into the task space and the null space, respectively, and synthesize laparoscope control commands via task-priority projection, thereby achieving consistent representation and coordinated fusion of multimodal information within a single framework. Finally, taking the intraoperative remote center of motion (RCM) position, force/torque sensor readings, and laparoscopic images as examples, we construct an RCM-constraint wrench to enforce the RCM geometric constraint and reduce the contact force at the trocar site, a laparoscope-manipulation wrench to enable compliant dragging, and an instrument-tracking wrench to achieve autonomous visual tracking of the instruments. Experiments on a surgical phantom and in vivo porcine trials demonstrate that the proposed method supports multi-task operation, including compliant laparoscope manipulation and autonomous instrument tracking, while maintaining the RCM constraint and reducing sustained trocar-site loading.
summary_zh: 腹腔镜持镜机器人能够为外科医生提供稳定的术中视野，并减轻人力辅助负担。为维持理想的手术视野，机器人需根据术中信息持续调整腹腔镜位姿。然而，术中位置、力/力矩、图像等多模态信号在物理意义与量纲上差异显著，难以构建统一表征并生成可直接用于腹腔镜控制的指令。为此，本文提出一种基于多模态信息统一力学建模的腹腔镜持镜机器人控制方法。首先，针对位置、力/力矩及图像等多源术中信息设计映射策略，将其统一表达为操作空间中的等效力旋量；随后采用任务优先级策略，将力旋量分别注入任务空间与零空间，通过任务优先级投影合成腹腔镜控制指令，从而在统一框架内实现多模态信息的一致表征与协调融合。最后，以术中远程运动中心位置、力/力矩传感器读数及腹腔镜图像为例，分别构建用于强化远程运动中心几何约束并降低套管接触力的约束力旋量、实现顺应性拖动的操作力旋量，以及完成手术器械自主视觉跟踪的追踪力旋量。在手术仿体与活体猪实验中，本方法在保持远程运动中心约束、降低持续套管负载的同时，成功实现了包含顺应性腹腔镜操控与自主器械跟踪在内的多任务操作。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified mechanics-based representation method for multimodal intraoperative signals (position, force, images) to enable autonomous control of a laparoscope-holding robot, achieving tasks like RCM constraint enforcement, compliant manipulation, and instrument tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于统一力学建模的多模态术中信息表示方法，用于自主控制腹腔镜持镜机器人，实现远程运动中心约束、顺应性拖拽和手术器械自动视觉跟踪等多任务操作。

title: Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models
summary: World model-based policy evaluation is a practical proxy for testing real-world robot control by rolling out candidate actions in action-conditioned video diffusion models. As these models increasingly adopt latent diffusion modeling (LDM), choosing the right latent space becomes critical. While the status quo uses autoencoding latent spaces like VAEs that are primarily trained for pixel reconstruction, recent work suggests benefits from pretrained encoders with representation-aligned semantic latent spaces. We systematically evaluate these latent spaces for action-conditioned LDM by comparing six reconstruction and semantic encoders to train world model variants under a fixed protocol on BridgeV2 dataset, and show effective world model training in high-dimensional representation spaces with and without dimension compression. We then propose three axes to assess robotic world model performance: visual fidelity, planning and downstream policy performance, and latent representation quality. Our results show visual fidelity alone is insufficient for world model selection. While reconstruction encoders like VAE and Cosmos achieve strong pixel-level scores, semantic encoders such as V-JEPA 2.1 (strongest overall on policy), Web-DINO, and SigLIP 2 generally excel across the other two axes at all model scales. Our study advocates semantic latent space as stronger foundation for policy-relevant robotics diffusion world models.
summary_zh: 基于世界模型的策略评估通过将候选动作在动作条件视频扩散模型中推演，为测试真实世界机器人控制提供了一种实用代理。随着这些模型日益采用潜在扩散模型，选择合适的潜在空间变得至关重要。虽然现状主要使用为像素重建而训练的自动编码潜在空间（如VAE），但最新研究表明，具有表征对齐语义潜在空间的预训练编码器能带来优势。我们通过在BridgeV2数据集上采用固定协议，比较六种重建与语义编码器来训练世界模型变体，系统评估了这些潜在空间在动作条件潜在扩散模型中的应用，并展示了在高维表征空间（无论是否进行维度压缩）中实现有效世界模型训练的可行性。进而提出评估机器人世界模型性能的三个维度：视觉保真度、规划与下游策略性能以及潜在表征质量。实验结果表明，仅凭视觉保真度不足以作为世界模型选择的依据。尽管VAE和Cosmos等重建编码器在像素级指标上表现优异，但V-JEPA 2.1（策略性能总体最优）、Web-DINO和SigLIP 2等语义编码器在所有模型规模上普遍在另外两个维度表现更优。本研究论证了语义潜在空间能为策略相关的机器人扩散世界模型提供更坚实的基础。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates whether reconstruction-focused or semantic latent spaces are more effective for training action-conditioned world models in robotics, finding that semantic encoders generally outperform on policy-relevant metrics despite weaker pixel-level reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了在机器人世界模型中，基于重建的潜空间与基于语义的潜空间哪个更有效。研究发现，在固定协议下，尽管重建编码器在像素级得分上表现更强，但语义编码器在规划和下游策略性能等更相关的指标上普遍表现更优，尤其适合策略相关的机器人扩散世界模型。

title: Structure-Preserving Gaussian Processes Via Discrete Euler-Lagrange Equations
summary: In this paper, we propose Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs) for probabilistic and data-efficient learning of dynamics via discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations. Importantly, the geometric structure of the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle, which governs the motion of dynamical systems, is preserved by construction in the absence of external forces. This allows learning physically consistent models that overcome erroneous drift in the system's energy, thereby providing stable long-term predictions. At the core of our approach lie linear operators for Gaussian process conditioning, constructed from discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations and variational discretization schemes. Thereby and unlike prior work, the method enables learning dynamics from discrete position snapshots, i.e., without access to a system's velocities or momenta. This is particularly relevant for a large class of practical scenarios where only position measurements are available, for instance, in motion capture or visual servoing applications. We demonstrate the data-efficiency and generalization capabilities of the LGPs in various synthetic and real-world case studies, including a real-world soft robot with hysteresis. The experimental results underscore that the LGPs learn physically consistent dynamics with uncertainty quantification solely from sparse positional data and enable stable long-term predictions.
summary_zh: 本文提出拉格朗日高斯过程（LGPs），通过离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程实现动力学系统的概率性数据高效学习。关键在于，该方法在构造上保持了支配动力学系统运动的拉格朗日-达朗贝尔原理的几何结构（无外力作用时），从而能够学习到物理一致的模型，克服系统能量漂移误差，实现稳定的长期预测。该方法的核心在于构建基于离散受迫欧拉-拉格朗日方程和变分离散化方案的高斯过程条件化线性算子。与现有研究不同，该方法支持仅通过离散位置快照学习动力学系统，即无需获取系统速度或动量信息。这对于仅能获得位置测量值的广泛实际应用场景（如运动捕捉或视觉伺服）具有特殊意义。我们通过多组合成与真实案例研究（包括具有迟滞效应的真实软体机器人）验证了LGPs的数据效率与泛化能力。实验结果表明，LGPs仅通过稀疏位置数据即可学习具有不确定度量化功能的物理一致动力学模型，并能实现稳定的长期预测。
tldr: This paper introduces Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs), a method for learning dynamical systems from only position data using discrete Euler-Lagrange equations. It preserves geometric structure to ensure physical consistency, enabling stable long-term predictions and uncertainty quantification, which is demonstrated on synthetic and real-world systems, including a soft robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出拉格朗日高斯过程（LGPs），一种利用离散欧拉-拉格朗日方程仅从位置数据学习动力学系统的方法。该方法保持了动力学系统的几何结构以确保物理一致性，从而能进行稳定的长期预测和不确定性量化，并在包括软体机器人在内的合成及真实系统上进行了验证。

title: DINO-MVR: Multi-View Readout of Frozen DINOv3 for Annotation-Efficient Medical Segmentation
summary: Adapting foundation models to medical segmentation typically requires either backbone fine-tuning or high-capacity task-specific decoders, both of which are difficult to fit reliably when annotations are scarce. We show that frozen DINOv3 features already contain useful structural and boundary cues for medical segmentation, and that the main bottleneck lies in how these features are read out. We propose DINO-MVR, a Multi-View Readout framework for annotation-efficient medical segmentation. DINO-MVR trains only lightweight MLP probes on features from the final three transformer blocks of a frozen DINOv3 backbone, without updating the backbone itself. At inference, each input is interpreted through complementary resolutions and test-time augmentations, whose probability maps are combined by entropy-weighted fusion and refined with simple spatial regularization. For volumetric inputs, Gaussian z-axis smoothing further improves inter-slice consistency. Under fixed evaluation protocols on endoscopy, dermoscopy, and MRI benchmarks, DINO-MVR achieves strong readout-only performance, including 0.895 Dice on Kvasir-SEG, 0.897 Dice on ISIC 2018, and 0.908 Dice on BraTS FLAIR whole-tumor segmentation. With only five annotated BraTS patients, it recovers 98.4% of the performance obtained by the 40-patient BraTS reference run. These results suggest that frozen self-supervised vision backbones can support accurate medical segmentation when paired with an effective multi-view readout.
summary_zh: 将基础模型应用于医学分割通常需要对骨干网络进行微调或使用高容量的任务特定解码器，这两种方法在标注数据稀缺时都难以可靠地适配。我们发现，冻结的DINOv3特征已包含可用于医学分割的结构与边界线索，其主要瓶颈在于如何读取这些特征。为此，我们提出DINO-MVR——一种面向高效标注医学分割的多视角读取框架。DINO-MVR仅需在冻结的DINOv3骨干网络最后三个Transformer块的特征上训练轻量级MLP探针，无需更新骨干网络本身。在推理阶段，每个输入通过互补的分辨率和测试时增强进行多视角解读，其概率图通过熵加权融合进行整合，并辅以简单的空间正则化进行优化。对于体数据输入，高斯Z轴平滑进一步提升了切片间的一致性。在内镜、皮肤镜和MRI基准的固定评估协议下，DINO-MVR实现了强劲的纯读取性能：Kvasir-SEG数据集上Dice系数达0.895，ISIC 2018达0.897，BraTS FLAIR全肿瘤分割达0.908。在仅使用5例标注的BraTS病例时，该方法即可达到40例标注病例参考实验性能的98.4%。这些结果表明，当配备有效的多视角读取机制时，冻结的自监督视觉骨干网络能够支持精确的医学图像分割。
tldr: Proposes DINO-MVR, a method for annotation-efficient medical image segmentation that uses a frozen DINOv3 backbone combined with lightweight MLP probes and a multi-view inference strategy, achieving strong performance on several benchmarks with very few annotated samples.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DINO-MVR，一种用于标注效率高的医学图像分割的方法。该方法使用冻结的DINOv3主干网络，结合轻量级MLP探针和多视图推理策略，在多个基准数据集上仅用极少量标注样本即实现了强劲性能。

title: Intention assimilation control for accurate tracking with variable impedance in teleoperation
summary: Robot systems for teleoperation commonly use a spring-like force pulling the follower robot towards the leader's position to track their movements. With this control strategy, the tracking accuracy deteriorates when the follower' stiffness is low, but high stiffness poses a danger to objects or people in the follower robot's environment. To address this trade-off between tracking accuracy and safety, we propose an alternative intention assimilation control (IAC) strategy where the robot's tracking accuracy can be ensured without high stiffness. Different from traditional approaches, which transmit the leader's current position to the follower, this new controller estimates the leader's target position and transmits it to the follower. With this strategy, the follower impedance can be changed on-the-fly to continuously reflect the user's desired impedance or modulated automatically to fulfill the task requirements. Our controller was validated on two 7 degree-of-freedom manipulators, yielding high tracking accuracy with varying impedance. Four experiments were conducted to compare {teleoperation} with IAC to tele-impedance control (TIC) during free tracking, interaction with a balloon, during peg insertion, and table polishing with force feedback. The results show that IAC increases tracking accuracy, improves task completion rate and reduces completion time. IAC enables the robot to accurately replicate the user's movement while giving them freedom to modulate the impedance according to their intention, providing an unprecedented level of control of the follower's position and its impedance during unilateral and bilateral teleoperation.
summary_zh: 远程操作机器人系统通常采用类弹簧力将跟随机器人拉向领导者位置以追踪其运动轨迹。在此控制策略下，当跟随机器人刚度较低时跟踪精度会下降，但高刚度又会对跟随机器人环境中的物体或人员构成安全威胁。为平衡跟踪精度与安全性之间的矛盾，我们提出一种创新的意图同化控制策略，该策略无需高刚度即可确保机器人跟踪精度。与传统方法向跟随者传递领导者当前位置不同，新控制器通过估计领导者的目标位置并将其传输给跟随者。基于此策略，跟随者阻抗可实时调整以持续反映用户期望的阻抗值，或根据任务需求自动调节。我们在两个七自由度机械臂上对控制器进行了验证，实现了变阻抗条件下的高精度跟踪。通过自由跟踪、气球交互、插孔操作及带力反馈的桌面抛光四项实验，将IAC与遥阻抗控制在遥操作场景中进行对比。结果表明：IAC能显著提升跟踪精度，提高任务完成率并缩短完成时间。该策略使机器人能够精确复现用户运动，同时允许用户根据意图自由调节阻抗，为单边及双边遥操作中跟随者的位置与阻抗控制提供了前所未有的操控水平。
tldr: This paper proposes a new control method called Intention Assimilation Control (IAC) for teleoperation robots, which estimates the leader's target position (rather than just the current position) to enable accurate tracking with low stiffness, improving both safety and performance.
tldr_zh: 本文为遥操作机器人提出了一种新的控制方法——意图同化控制（IAC）。该方法通过估计操作者的目标位置（而非当前位姿），使得从端机器人能在低刚度下实现精确跟踪，同时兼顾了安全性和任务性能。

title: ImplantMamba: Long-range Sequential Modeling Mamba For Dental Implant Position Prediction
summary: In the design of surgical guides for implant placement, determining the precise implant position is a critical step. However, the implant region itself is often characterized by a lack of distinctive texture in medical images. Consequently, artificial intelligence (AI) models must infer the correct implant position and angulation (slope) primarily by analyzing the texture of the surrounding teeth, which poses a significant challenge. To address this, we propose ImplantMamba, a network architecture designed for long-range sequential modeling to integrate texture information from adjacent teeth. Our approach explicitly couples the regression of the implant position with its slope. The core of ImplantMamba is a hybrid encoder that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Mamba layers. This design enables the network to hierarchically extract local anatomical features through CNNs while simultaneously modeling global contextual dependencies across the entire scan volume via Mamba's selective scan operations, leading to a more comprehensive understanding of the implant site. Furthermore, we introduce a Slope-Coupled Prediction Branch (SCP). This branch is designed to connect the prediction of implant position with the slope, ensuring internal consistency and anatomical plausibility by thereby enforcing a coherent relationship between the predicted implant location and its angulation. Extensive experiments on a large-scale dental implant dataset demonstrate that the proposed ImplantMamba achieves superior performance compared to existing methods.
summary_zh: 在种植手术导板的设计中，确定精确的种植体位置是关键步骤。然而，医学影像中的种植区域本身常缺乏显著纹理特征。因此，人工智能模型必须主要通过分析周围牙齿的纹理来推断正确的种植体位置与倾斜角度，这构成了重大挑战。为此，我们提出ImplantMamba——一种专为长程序列建模设计的网络架构，以整合邻牙纹理信息。该方法显式地将种植体位置回归与其倾斜角度预测进行耦合。ImplantMamba的核心是结合卷积神经网络与Mamba层的混合编码器，该设计使网络能够通过CNN分层提取局部解剖特征，同时借助Mamba的选择性扫描操作对整个扫描影像进行全局上下文依赖建模，从而实现对种植位点更全面的理解。此外，我们引入了倾斜角度耦合预测分支，该分支通过连接种植体位置与倾斜角度的预测，确保两者间的内在一致性，从而强制预测的种植体位置与其倾斜角度形成协调的解剖学合理关系。在大规模牙科种植数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的ImplantMamba相较于现有方法取得了更优的性能。
tldr: The paper proposes ImplantMamba, a hybrid CNN-Mamba network for predicting dental implant position and angulation, using a Slope-Coupled Prediction Branch to enforce consistency by modeling long-range dependencies from surrounding teeth textures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ImplantMamba，一种用于预测种植牙位置和角度的混合CNN-Mamba网络，通过斜率耦合预测分支确保一致性，利用周围牙齿的纹理进行长程依赖建模。

title: From Articulated Kinematics to Routed Visual Control for Action-Conditioned Surgical Video Generation
summary: Action-conditioned surgical video generation is a critical yet highly challenging problem for robotic surgery. The core difficulty is that low-dimensional control vectors must precisely govern complex image-space evolution. In this work, we propose a kinematic-to-visual lifting paradigm that converts articulated kinematics into a unified set of five image-aligned control modalities. Building on this representation, we introduce a hierarchically routed visual control framework that selectively activates the most relevant control modalities and motion scales. Instead of uniformly applying all control signals, our model performs hierarchical routing to dynamically allocate conditioning capacity. We further design kinematic-prior-guided routing loss functions to ensure physically meaningful, temporally stable, and efficient expert utilization. To improve efficiency, we propose a budgeted training and inference scheme that leverages routing-induced sparsity. By selectively discarding low-significance control pathways during training and execution, our approach enables adaptive computation that is complementary to standard distillation. We additionally construct a new benchmark with curated articulated annotations, obtained through human-in-the-loop semantic labeling and differentiable pose tracking, providing realistic supervision for action-conditioned surgical video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves action faithfulness, visual fidelity, and cross-domain generalization over diverse baselines. Moreover, our efficient variant achieves substantial reductions in latency while maintaining strong control accuracy.
summary_zh: 动作条件化手术视频生成是机器人手术领域至关重要且极具挑战性的问题，其核心难点在于低维控制向量必须精确引导复杂的图像空间演化。本研究提出了一种运动学-视觉提升范式，将关节运动学转化为统一的五类图像对齐控制模式。基于此表征，我们引入了一种分层路由的视觉控制框架，能够选择性激活最相关的控制模式与运动尺度。该模型并非均匀施加所有控制信号，而是通过分层路由动态分配调节能力。我们进一步设计了运动学先验引导的路由损失函数，以确保物理意义明确、时序稳定且高效的专家模块利用率。为提升效率，我们提出了一种基于预算的训练与推理方案，利用路由诱导的稀疏性。通过在训练和执行过程中选择性舍弃低显著性控制路径，我们的方法实现了自适应计算，与标准蒸馏技术形成互补。此外，我们构建了包含精细关节标注的新基准数据集，通过人机协同语义标注与可微分姿态跟踪获得，为动作条件化手术视频生成提供了真实监督信号。大量实验表明，相较于多种基线方法，我们的模型在动作保真度、视觉真实性与跨域泛化能力方面均取得持续提升。更高效的本模型变体在保持强劲控制精度的同时，实现了显著延迟降低。
tldr: This paper proposes a kinematic-to-visual lifting framework for action-conditioned surgical video generation. It uses hierarchically routed visual control to dynamically allocate conditioning capacity, guided by kinematic priors, and achieves improved action faithfulness and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于动作条件手术视频生成的从运动学提升到视觉控制的框架。该方法使用分层路由的视觉控制来动态分配调节能力，并以运动学先验为指导，实现了动作忠实度和效率的提升。

title: Continuum Robot Modeling with Action Conditioned Flow Matching
summary: Predicting the shape of tendon driven continuum robots (TDCRs) at steady state from actuation remains challenging due to continuous deformation, complex tendon routing, compliance, friction, and fabrication variability. In this paper, we address this problem as kinematic self modeling conditioned on action. We present a lightweight 3D printed TDCR hardware platform and an RGB-D data collection pipeline with multiple cameras, and we learn a point cloud flow matching model that maps motor actuation states to the robot's settled 3D geometry. The model is trained from randomly sampled quasi static configurations and evaluated on test motor commands within the same TDCR design family and actuation range. We compare against prior 3D deformable object and robot self modeling approaches in both MuJoCo simulation and real hardware experiments. Experiments on simulated 2-, 3-, and 5-module TDCRs and real 2- and 3-module robots show improved shape prediction accuracy under CD and EMD metrics. We further show in simulation that the same conditional formulation generalizes to tip payload as a conditioning input, enabling payload conditioned steady-state shape prediction. These results demonstrate a data driven self modeling framework for quasi static TDCR geometry prediction.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于连续变形、复杂的肌腱路径、柔顺性、摩擦和制造差异性，从驱动状态预测肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR）的稳态形状仍具挑战性。本文将该问题视为基于动作的机器人运动学自建模。我们提出了一种轻量化的3D打印TDCR硬件平台和基于多摄像头的RGB-D数据采集流程，并学习了一种点云流匹配模型，该模型将电机驱动状态映射至机器人的稳定三维几何形态。模型通过随机采样的准静态构型进行训练，并在相同TDCR设计族系和驱动范围内的测试电机指令上进行评估。我们在MuJoCo仿真和真实硬件实验中，与现有的三维可变形物体及机器人自建模方法进行了对比。在仿真中的2单元、3单元、5单元TDCR以及真实的2单元和3单元机器人上的实验表明，该方法在CD和EMD指标下提高了形状预测精度。我们进一步在仿真中证明，相同的条件建模框架可扩展至以末端负载为条件输入，实现负载条件下的稳态形状预测。这些结果展示了一种用于准静态TDCR几何预测的数据驱动自建模框架。
tldr: The paper introduces a data-driven method using action-conditioned flow matching to predict the steady-state 3D shape of tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) from motor actuation commands. It demonstrates improved accuracy over prior methods and shows the model can also condition on tip payload for shape prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于动作条件流匹配的数据驱动方法，用于从电机驱动状态预测绳驱连续体机器人的稳态3D形状。该方法在模拟和真实硬件上展示了比现有方法更高的精度，并证明该模型也可利用末端负载作为条件输入进行形状预测。

title: ForceFlow: Learning to Feel and Act via Contact-Driven Flow Matching
summary: Existing imitation learning methods enable robots to interact autonomously with the physical environment. However, contact-rich manipulation tasks remain a significant challenge due to complex contact dynamics that demand high-precision force feedback and control. Although recent efforts have attempted to integrate force/torque sensing into policies, how to build a simple yet effective framework that achieves robust generalization under multimodal observations remains an open question. In this paper, we propose ForceFlow, a force-aware reactive framework built upon flow matching. For contact-stage policy design, we investigate force signal fusion mechanisms and adopt an asymmetric multimodal fusion architecture that treats force as a global regulatory signal, combined with a joint prediction paradigm that enhances the policy's understanding of instantaneous force and historical information, thereby achieving deep coupling between force and motion. For task-level hierarchical decomposition, we divide manipulation into a vision-dominant approach stage (VLM-based pointing for target localization) and a touch-dominant interaction stage (force-driven contact execution), with a Vision-to-Force (V2F) handover mechanism that explicitly decouples spatial generalization from contact regulation. Experimental results across six real-world contact-rich tasks demonstrate that ForceFlow achieves a 37% success rate improvement over the strong baseline ForceVLA while maintaining significantly lower cost. Moreover, ForceFlow exhibits accurate force signal prediction and demonstrates superior performance in contact force self-regulation and zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.
