summary_zh: 现有模仿学习方法使机器人能够自主与物理环境交互。然而，由于接触动力学复杂且需要高精度力反馈与控制，接触密集型操作任务仍面临重大挑战。尽管近期研究尝试将力/力矩传感融入策略模型，但如何构建简单有效的框架以实现多模态观测下的鲁棒泛化仍是一个开放问题。本文提出ForceFlow——一种基于流匹配的力感知反应框架。针对接触阶段的策略设计，我们研究了力信号融合机制，采用非对称多模态融合架构，将力作为全局调控信号，并结合联合预测范式以增强策略对瞬时力与历史信息的理解，从而实现了力与运动的深度耦合。在任务级分层分解方面，我们将操作任务划分为视觉主导的接近阶段（基于VLM的指向目标定位）与触觉主导的交互阶段（力驱动的接触执行），通过视觉到力量（V2F）交接机制显式解耦空间泛化与接触调控。在六项真实世界接触密集型任务中的实验结果表明，ForceFlow在保持显著更低成本的同时，比强基线方法ForceVLA实现了37%的成功率提升。此外，ForceFlow展现出精确的力信号预测能力，并在接触力自调节与零样本分布外泛化方面表现出卓越性能。
tldr: ForceFlow is a framework for contact-rich robotic manipulation that uses force as a global regulatory signal within a flow matching policy, and employs a two-stage hierarchical architecture (vision-based approach followed by force-driven interaction) to decouple and improve generalization.
tldr_zh: ForceFlow 是一个用于接触密集型机器人操作的框架，它通过在流匹配策略中将力作为全局调节信号，并采用两阶段分层架构（基于视觉的接近和基于力的接触）来解耦任务并提升泛化能力。

title: Checkup2Action: A Multimodal Clinical Check-up Report Dataset for Patient-Oriented Action Card Generation
summary: Clinical check-up reports are multimodal documents that combine page layouts, tables, numerical biomarkers, abnormality flags, imaging findings, and domain-specific terminology. Such heterogeneous evidence is difficult for laypersons to interpret and translate into concrete follow-up actions. Although large language models show promise in medical summarisation and triage support, their ability to generate safe, prioritised, and patient-oriented actions from multimodal check-up reports remains under-benchmarked. We present \textbf{Checkup2Action}, a multimodal clinical check-up report dataset and benchmark for structured \textit{Action Card} generation. Each card describes one clinically relevant issue and specifies its priority, recommended department, follow-up time window, patient-facing explanation, and questions for clinicians, while avoiding diagnostic or treatment-prescriptive claims. The dataset contains 2,000 de-identified real-world check-up reports covering demographic information, physical examinations, laboratory tests, cardiovascular assessments, and imaging-related evidence. We formulate checkup-to-action generation as a constrained structured generation task and introduce an evaluation protocol covering issue coverage and precision, priority consistency, department and time recommendation accuracy, action complexity, usefulness, readability, and safety compliance. Experiments with general-purpose and medical large language models reveal clear trade-offs between issue coverage, action correctness, conciseness, and safety alignment. Checkup2Action provides a new multimodal benchmark for evaluating patient-oriented reasoning over clinical check-up reports.
summary_zh: 临床检查报告是多模态文档，融合了版面布局、表格、数值化生物标志物、异常标志、影像学发现及领域专业术语。此类异构证据对普通人而言难以解读并转化为具体的后续行动。虽然大型语言模型在医疗摘要和分诊支持方面展现出潜力，但其从多模态检查报告中生成安全、优先级明确且以患者为导向的行动建议能力，仍缺乏充分的基准测试。我们提出\textbf{Checkup2Action}——一个面向结构化\textit{行动卡片}生成的多模态临床检查报告数据集与基准测试框架。每张卡片描述一个临床相关异常问题，明确其优先级、建议科室、随访时间窗口、面向患者的解释说明以及面向临床医生的提问建议，同时避免诊断性或治疗性处方表述。该数据集包含2,000份经去标识处理的真实世界检查报告，涵盖人口统计学信息、体格检查、实验室检测、心血管评估及影像学相关证据。我们将"检查报告-行动建议"生成任务定义为约束性结构化生成问题，并提出覆盖异常问题覆盖率和精确度、优先级一致性、科室与时间建议准确性、行动复杂度、实用性、可读性及安全合规性的评估体系。通过对通用及医学专用大语言模型的实验，揭示了异常问题覆盖率、行动正确性、简洁度与安全性对齐之间的显著权衡关系。Checkup2Action为评估面向临床检查报告的以患者为导向的推理能力提供了新的多模态基准。
tldr: The paper introduces Checkup2Action, a multimodal dataset and benchmark for generating structured, patient-oriented action cards from complex clinical check-up reports. It evaluates the ability of large language models to safely extract and prioritize actionable follow-up steps without making diagnostic claims.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Checkup2Action，这是一个多模态临床检查报告数据集和基准，用于从复杂的检查报告中生成结构化的、以患者为导向的行动卡。它评估了大型语言模型安全地提取和优先处理可操作的随访步骤，而不做出诊断性断言的性能。

title: Towards Unified Surgical Scene Understanding:Bridging Reasoning and Grounding via MLLMs
summary: Surgical scene understanding is a cornerstone of computer-assisted intervention. While recent advances, particularly in surgical image segmentation, have driven progress, real-world clinical applications require a more holistic understanding that jointly captures procedural context, semantic reasoning, and precise visual grounding. However, existing approaches typically address these components in isolation, leading to fragmented representations and limited semantic consistency. To address this limitation, we propose SurgMLLM, a unified surgical scene understanding framework that bridges high-level reasoning and low-level visual grounding within a single model. Given surgical videos, SurgMLLM fine-tunes a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to support structured interpretability reasoning, which is used to jointly model phases, instrument-verb-target (IVT) triplets, and triplet-entity segmentation tokens. These tokens are then temporally aggregated and serve as prompts for a segmentation network, enabling accurate pixel-wise grounding of triplet instruments and targets. The entire framework is trained end-to-end with a unified objective that couples language-based reasoning supervision with visual grounding losses, promoting coherent cross-task learning and clinically consistent scene representations. To facilitate unified evaluation, we introduce CholecT45-Scene, extending CholecT45 dataset with 64,299 frames of pixel-level mask annotations for instruments and targets, aligned with existing triplet labels. Extensive experiments show that SurgMLLM significantly advances surgical scene understanding, improving the primary triplet recognition metric AP_IVT from 40.7% to 46.0% and consistently outperforming prior methods in phase recognition and segmentation. These results highlight the effectiveness of unified reasoning-and-grounding for reliable, context-aware surgical assistance.
summary_zh: 手术场景理解是计算机辅助干预的基石。尽管近年来的进展（特别是手术图像分割领域）推动了该领域的发展，但实际临床应用需要更全面的理解能力——能够同时捕捉手术流程语境、语义推理及精确的视觉定位。然而，现有方法通常孤立处理这些组件，导致表征碎片化与语义一致性不足。为突破此局限，我们提出SurgMLLM——一个统一的手术场景理解框架，将高层推理与低层视觉定位融合于单一模型中。针对手术视频输入，SurgMLLM通过微调多模态大语言模型实现结构化可解释推理，同步建模手术阶段、器械-动词-目标三元组及三元组实体分割标记。这些标记经时序聚合后作为分割网络的提示信息，实现对三元组器械与目标的精确像素级定位。整个框架通过耦合语言推理监督与视觉定位损失的统一目标进行端到端训练，促进跨任务协同学习并生成临床一致的场景表征。为支持统一评估，我们构建了CholecT45-Scene数据集，在CholecT45基础上扩充了64,299帧器械与目标的像素级掩码标注，并与现有三元组标签对齐。大量实验表明，SurgMLLM显著推进了手术场景理解：核心三元组识别指标AP_IVT从40.7%提升至46.0%，在阶段识别与分割任务上均持续超越现有方法。这些成果验证了统一推理-定位框架对于实现可靠、情境感知手术辅助的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces SurgMLLM, a unified framework for surgical scene understanding that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to jointly perform high-level reasoning (e.g., phase recognition, IVT triplet prediction) and low-level visual grounding (pixel-wise segmentation). It is trained end-to-end and evaluated on a newly extended dataset, showing improved performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 SurgMLLM，一个用于手术场景理解的统一框架。它使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）联合执行高级推理（如阶段识别、IVT三元组预测）和低级视觉定位（像素级分割），并进行端到端训练。在一个新扩展的数据集上评估，显示出更好的性能。

title: VoxCor: Training-Free Volumetric Features for Multimodal Voxel Correspondence
summary: Cross-modal 3D medical image analysis requires voxelwise representations that remain anatomically consistent across imaging contrasts, scanners, and acquisition protocols. Recent work has shown that frozen 2D Vision Transformer (ViT) foundation models can support such representations, but typical pipelines extract features along a single anatomical axis and adapt those features inside a registration solver for one image pair at a time, leaving complementary viewing directions unused and producing representations that do not transfer to new volumes. We introduce VoxCor, a training-free fit--transform method for reusable volumetric feature representations from frozen 2D ViT foundation models. During an offline fitting phase, VoxCor combines triplanar ViT inference with a compact closed-form weighted partial least squares (WPLS) projection that uses fitting-time voxel correspondences to select modality-stable anatomical directions in the triplanar feature space. At transform time, new volumes are mapped by triplanar ViT inference and linear projection alone, without fine-tuning or registration. Voxel correspondences can then be queried directly by nearest-neighbor search. We evaluate VoxCor on intra-subject Abdomen MR--CT and inter-subject HCP T2w--T1w tasks using deformable registration, voxelwise k-nearest-neighbor segmentation, and segmentation-center landmark localization. VoxCor improves the hardest cross-subject, cross-modality transfer settings, reduces encoder sensitivity for dense correspondence transfer, and yields registration performance competitive with handcrafted descriptors and learned 3D features. This positions VoxCor as a reusable feature layer for downstream multimodal analysis beyond pairwise registration. Code, configuration files, and implementation details are publicly available on GitHub at \href{https://github.com/guneytombak/VoxCor}{guneytombak/VoxCor}.
summary_zh: 跨模态三维医学图像分析需要能够跨成像对比度、扫描设备和采集协议保持解剖结构一致性的体素级表征。现有研究表明，冻结的二维视觉Transformer（ViT）基础模型可支持此类表征，但典型流程仅沿单一解剖轴提取特征，并在配准求解器中针对单幅图像对进行特征适配，导致其他互补的观察方向未被利用，且生成的表征无法迁移至新体积数据。本文提出VoxCor——一种基于冻结二维ViT基础模型、无需训练即可生成可复用体积特征表征的拟合-变换方法。在离线拟合阶段，VoxCor将三平面ViT推理与紧凑的闭式加权偏最小二乘（WPLS）投影相结合，利用拟合阶段的体素对应关系在三平面特征空间中选择模态稳定的解剖方向。在变换阶段，新体积数据仅通过三平面ViT推理和线性投影完成映射，无需微调或配准操作。随后可通过最近邻搜索直接查询体素对应关系。我们在受试者腹部的MR-CT跨模态任务及跨受试者HCP的T2w-T1w任务上，通过可变形配准、体素级k近邻分割以及分割中心点定位进行评估。实验表明，VoxCor在最具挑战性的跨受试者、跨模态迁移场景中表现优异，降低了密集对应迁移的编码器敏感性，其配准性能可与手工描述符及学习型三维特征相媲美。这使VoxCor成为超越成对配准的下游多模态分析中可复用的特征层。代码、配置文件及实现细节已在GitHub开源：\href{https://github.com/guneytombak/VoxCor}{guneytombak/VoxCor}。
tldr: VoxCor is a training-free method that creates reusable volumetric features from frozen 2D Vision Transformers for establishing consistent voxel correspondences across different 3D medical imaging modalities (e.g., MR-CT). It combines triplanar feature extraction with a weighted partial least squares projection during a fitting phase, enabling direct nearest-neighbor search for correspondence at test time without fine-tuning or registration for each new volume pair.
tldr_zh: VoxCor 是一种免训练方法，利用冻结的 2D 视觉变换器生成可重用的体素特征，用于在不同 3D 医学成像模态（如 MR-CT）之间建立一致的体素对应关系。它在拟合阶段结合了三平面特征提取和加权偏最小二乘投影，从而在测试时无需针对每个新体对进行微调或配准，即可通过最近邻搜索直接查询体素对应关系。

title: SurgicalMamba: Dual-Path SSD with State Regramming for Online Surgical Phase Recognition
summary: Online surgical phase recognition (SPR) underpins context-aware operating-room systems and requires committing to a prediction at every frame from past context alone. Surgical video poses three demands that natural-video recognizers do not jointly address: procedures span tens of thousands of frames, time flows non-uniformly as long routine stretches are punctuated by brief phase-defining transitions, and the visual domain is narrow so backbone features are strongly correlated across channels. Existing recognizers either let per-frame cost grow with elapsed length, or hold cost bounded but advance state at a uniform rate with channel-independent dynamics, leaving the latter two demands unaddressed. We present SurgicalMamba, a causal SPR model built on Mamba2's structured state-space duality (SSD) that holds per-frame cost at O(d). It introduces three SSD-compatible components, each targeting one demand: a dual-path SSD block that separates long- and short-term regimes at the level of recurrent state; intensity-modulated stepping, a continuous-time time-warp that adapts the slow path's effective rate to phase-relevant information; and state regramming, a per-chunk Cayley rotation that opens cross-channel mixing in the otherwise axis-aligned SSM recurrence. The learned rotation planes inherit a phase-aligned structure without any direct supervision, offering an interpretable internal signature of surgical workflow. Across seven public SPR benchmarks, SurgicalMamba reaches state-of-the-art accuracy and phase-level Jaccard under strict online evaluation: 94.6%/82.7% on Cholec80 (+0.7 pp/+2.2 pp over the strongest prior) and 89.5%/68.9% on AutoLaparo (+1.7 pp/+2.0 pp), at 119 fps on a single GPU. Ablations isolate the contribution of each component. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sukjuoh/Surgical-Mamba.
summary_zh: 在线手术阶段识别（SPR）是情境感知手术室系统的核心支撑技术，其要求仅依据历史上下文对每一帧画面即时做出预测。手术视频具有三个自然视频识别器未共同应对的需求：手术流程长达数万帧；时间流逝非均匀，漫长常规操作段间穿插着短暂而决定阶段转换的关键时刻；视觉域狭窄，导致骨干网络特征在通道间高度相关。现有识别器要么使单帧处理成本随已处理时长增长，要么控制成本恒定但以均匀速率推进状态并采用通道独立动态机制，未能解决后两个需求。本文提出SurgicalMamba——一种基于Mamba2结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）构建的因果SPR模型，将单帧计算成本控制在O(d)。我们引入三个SSD兼容组件，分别针对上述需求：在循环状态层面分离长短期机制的**双路径SSD模块**；通过连续时间扭曲自适应调整慢路径有效速率以适应阶段相关信息的**强度调制步进机制**；以及通过每数据块的**凯莱旋转实现状态重组**，在原本轴对齐的SSM循环中开启跨通道混合。学习到的旋转平面在没有直接监督的情况下继承了阶段对齐结构，为手术工作流提供了可解释的内部特征表征。在七个公开SPR基准测试中，SurgicalMamba在严格在线评估下达到最先进的精度和阶段级杰卡德系数：在Cholec80数据集上达94.6%/82.7%（较先前最优结果提升0.7个百分点/2.2个百分点），在AutoLaparo数据集上达89.5%/68.9%（提升1.7个百分点/2.0个百分点），单GPU推理速度达119帧/秒。消融实验验证了各组件的独立贡献。代码公开于https://github.com/sukjuoh/Surgical-Mamba。
tldr: This paper presents SurgicalMamba, a novel online surgical phase recognition model based on the Mamba2 structured state-space duality (SSD). It introduces three SSD-compatible components to address the unique challenges of surgical video (long duration, non-uniform time flow, and strong channel correlations), achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and speed on multiple public benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SurgicalMamba，一种基于Mamba2结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）的新型在线手术阶段识别模型。它引入了三个SSD兼容的组件，以解决手术视频的独特挑战（时长、非均匀时间流、强通道相关性），在多个公开基准上实现了最先进的准确性和速度。

title: Towards Real-Time Autonomous Navigation: Transformer-Based Catheter Tip Tracking in Fluoroscopy
summary: Purpose: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) improves stroke outcomes, but is limited by a lack of local treatment access. Widespread distribution of reinforcement learning (RL)-based robotic systems can be used to alleviate this challenge through autonomous navigation, but current RL methods require live device tip coordinate tracking to function. This paper aims to develop and evaluate a real-time catheter tip tracking pipeline under fluoroscopy, addressing challenges such as low contrast, noise, and device occlusion. Methods: A multi-threaded pipeline was designed, incorporating frame reading, preprocessing, inference, and post-processing. Deep learning segmentation models, including U-Net, U-Net+Transformer, and SegFormer, were trained and benchmarked using two-class and three-class formulations. Post-processing involved two-step component filtering, one-pixel medial skeletonization, and greedy arc-length path following with contour fall-back. Results: On manually-labeled moderate complexity fluoroscopic video data, the two-class SegFormer achieved a mean absolute error of 4.44 mm, outperforming U-Net (4.60 mm), U-Net+Transformer (6.20 mm) and all three-class models (5.19-7.74 mm). On segmentation benchmarks, the system exceeded state-of-the-art CathAction results with improvements of up to +5% in Dice scores for three-segmentation. Conclusion: The results demonstrate that the proposed multi-threaded tracking framework maintains stable performance under challenging imaging conditions, outperforming prior benchmarks, while providing a reliable and efficient foundation for RL-based autonomous MT navigation.
summary_zh: 目的：机械取栓虽可改善卒中预后，但受限于本地治疗资源不足。基于强化学习的机器人系统若能广泛部署，可通过自主导航缓解这一难题，但现有强化学习方法需依赖实时的导管尖端坐标追踪。本文旨在开发并评估一种血管造影下的实时导管尖端追踪流程，以应对低对比度、噪声及器械遮挡等挑战。方法：设计包含帧读取、预处理、推理与后处理的多线程处理流程。采用深度学习分割模型（包括U-Net、U-Net+Transformer与SegFormer）进行训练，并通过二分类与三分类架构进行性能比较。后处理流程包含两步分量滤波、单像素中轴骨架化、结合轮廓回退的贪婪弧长路径追踪。结果：在人工标注的中等复杂度血管造影视频数据上，二分类SegFormer模型的平均绝对误差为4.44毫米，优于U-Net（4.60毫米）、U-Net+Transformer（6.20毫米）及所有三分类模型（5.19-7.74毫米）。在分割性能基准测试中，本系统超越现有CathAction最佳结果，三分割任务的戴斯系数最高提升5%。结论：结果表明，所提出的多线程追踪框架在挑战性成像条件下保持稳定性能，优于现有基准测试结果，为基于强化学习的机械取栓自主导航提供了可靠高效的技术基础。
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time, multi-threaded pipeline for tracking catheter tips in fluoroscopy using deep learning segmentation models (like SegFormer) to enable RL-based autonomous navigation for mechanical thrombectomy, outperforming prior benchmarks in tracking accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于在透视下实时跟踪导管尖端的多线程流程，使用深度学习分割模型（如 SegFormer），以支持基于强化学习的机械取栓自主导航，在跟踪精度上超过了现有基准。

title: Agentifying Patient Dynamics within LLMs through Interacting with Clinical World Model
summary: Sepsis management in the ICU requires sequential treatment decisions under rapidly evolving patient physiology. Although large language models (LLMs) encode broad clinical knowledge and can reason over guidelines, they are not inherently grounded in action-conditioned patient dynamics. We introduce SepsisAgent, a world model-augmented LLM agent for sepsis treatment recommendation. SepsisAgent uses a learned Clinical World Model to simulate patient responses under candidate fluid--vasopressor interventions, and follows a propose--simulate--refine workflow before committing to a prescription. We first show that world-model access alone yields inconsistent LLM decision performance, motivating agent-specific training. We then train SepsisAgent through a three-stage curriculum: patient-dynamics supervised fine-tuning, propose--simulate--refine behavior cloning, and world-model-based agentic reinforcement learning. On MIMIC-IV sepsis trajectories, SepsisAgent outperforms all traditional RL and LLM-based baselines in off-policy value while achieving the best safety profile under guideline adherence and unsafe-action metrics. Further analysis shows that repeated interaction with the Clinical World Model enables the agent to learn regularities in patient evolution, which remain useful even when simulator access is removed.
summary_zh: ICU脓毒症管理需要在快速演变的患者生理状态下进行序贯治疗决策。尽管大语言模型编码了广泛的临床知识并能依据指南进行推理，但其本质上缺乏对行动条件化患者动态的认知基础。本文提出SepsisAgent——一种基于世界模型增强的大语言模型智能体，用于脓毒症治疗推荐。该智能体通过习得的临床世界模型对候选输液-升压药干预下的患者反应进行模拟，并遵循"提议-模拟-优化"工作流程后最终确定处方方案。我们首先证明仅依赖世界模型会导致大语言模型决策性能不稳定，这促使我们开展针对智能体的专项训练。随后通过三阶段课程训练SepsisAgent：患者动态监督微调、提议-模拟-优化行为克隆，以及基于世界模型的智能体强化学习。在MIMIC-IV脓毒症诊疗轨迹数据中，SepsisAgent在离线策略价值评估上优于所有传统强化学习及基于大语言模型的基线方法，同时在指南遵循性和不安全行为指标方面展现出最优的安全性。进一步分析表明，通过与临床世界模型的反复交互，智能体能够掌握患者状态演变的规律性，这种认知即使在移除模拟器后依然持续有效。
tldr: This paper introduces SepsisAgent, an LLM-based agent for sepsis treatment recommendations that uses a learned Clinical World Model to simulate patient responses to interventions. It is trained via a three-stage curriculum and outperforms traditional RL and LLM baselines in safety and policy value on ICU data.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SepsisAgent，一种用于脓毒症治疗建议的基于大语言模型的智能体。它通过一个学习的临床世界模型来模拟患者对干预措施的反应，并采用三阶段课程进行训练。在ICU数据上，它在安全性和策略价值方面优于传统的强化学习和基于大语言模型的基线方法。

title: Computational Imaging Priors for Wireless Capsule Endoscopy: Monte Carlo-Guided Hemoglobin Mapping for Rare-Anomaly Detection
summary:
Background. RGB-trained capsule-endoscopy classifiers underperform on small-vessel vascular findings by
  conflating hemoglobin contrast with bile and illumination falloff. Thus, here we test whether a Monte
  Carlo-inspired analytic model can compute hemoglobin from RGB signal built upon extracted classifier.
  Methods. On Kvasir-Capsule (47,238 frames, video-level 70/15/15 split, 11 evaluable classes) we evaluate two
  software-only configurations against RGB-only EfficientNet-B0 across 6 seeds: (i) a prior P_blood =
  sigma(alpha * (H_norm - 0.5)) * Phi(r) fused as 2 zero-init auxiliary channels; (ii) a distillation head
  training a 3-channel RGB backbone to predict P_blood. Significance: paired DeLong, McNemar, bootstrap CIs
  with Bonferroni correction.
  Results. Across 6 seeds (n=6,423), the analytic prior provides a small but direction-consistent macro-AUC
  improvement: RGB-only 0.760 +/- 0.027, input-fusion 0.783 +/- 0.024 (paired Delta = +0.023, sign-positive on
  5/6 seeds), distillation 0.773 +/- 0.028. The largest robust per-class lift is on Lymphangiectasia, where AUC
  rises from RGB 0.238 +/- 0.057 to input-fusion 0.337 +/- 0.019, sign-consistent across all 6 seeds. On rare
  focal-vascular classes (Angiectasia, Blood - fresh) the prior's per-seed effects are bimodal: seed=42 reaches
  Angiectasia AUC 0.528 -> 0.916, but the cross-seed mean is 0.646 -> 0.608 with sigma_PI = 0.23 - reported as
  a high-variance per-seed exemplar.
  Conclusion. A Monte Carlo-inspired analytic prior provides a small, direction-consistent macro-AUC
  improvement on Kvasir-Capsule across 6 seeds with the largest robust per-class lift on Lymphangiectasia; the
  distillation variant runs on plain 3-channel RGB and yields a free interpretability heatmap.
summary_zh: 背景。基于RGB训练的胶囊内镜分类器在小血管病变识别上表现欠佳，主要原因是将血红蛋白对比度与胆汁及照明衰减效应相混淆。因此，本研究测试了一种受蒙特卡洛方法启发的分析模型，该模型能否通过基于已有分类器提取的RGB信号计算血红蛋白含量。方法。在Kvasir-Capsule数据集（47,238帧图像，视频级70/15/15划分，11个可评估类别）上，我们评估了两种纯软件配置方案，并与纯RGB的EfficientNet-B0模型在6次随机种子下进行对比：（i）采用先验概率P_blood = sigma(alpha * (H_norm - 0.5)) * Phi(r)作为两个零初始化辅助通道进行融合；（ii）通过蒸馏头训练3通道RGB主干网络预测P_blood。显著性检验采用配对DeLong检验、McNemar检验及经过Bonferroni校正的Bootstrap置信区间。结果。在6次随机种子实验中（n=6,423），分析先验模型带来了虽小但方向一致的宏观AUC提升：纯RGB模型0.760 +/- 0.027，输入融合模型0.783 +/- 0.024（配对Δ = +0.023，5/6次种子呈正向提升），蒸馏模型0.773 +/- 0.028。最显著的稳健类别提升出现在淋巴管扩张症，AUC从纯RGB的0.238 +/- 0.057提升至输入融合模型的0.337 +/- 0.019，6次种子结果均呈一致正向趋势。在罕见局灶性血管病变（血管扩张症、新鲜出血）上，先验模型的种子间效应呈双峰分布：种子42使血管扩张症AUC从0.528提升至0.916，但跨种子均值从0.646变为0.608（σ_PI = 0.23），这被报告为高方差的单种子示例。结论。受蒙特卡洛启发的分析先验模型在Kvasir-Capsule数据集6次种子实验中带来了虽小但方向一致的宏观AUC提升，其中对淋巴管扩张症的类别提升最为显著且稳健；蒸馏变体可在普通3通道RGB系统上运行，并免费提供可解释性热力图。
tldr: This paper proposes using a Monte Carlo-inspired analytic model to compute hemoglobin concentration from RGB signals in wireless capsule endoscopy video frames. By incorporating this prior as additional input channels or via distillation, the method achieves modest but consistent improvements in macro-AUC for classifying rare vascular anomalies, with the largest robust gain on Lymphangiectasia.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用蒙特卡洛启发的分析模型从无线胶囊内窥镜的RGB信号中计算血红蛋白浓度。通过将该先验知识作为额外输入通道或通过蒸馏方法融入模型，该技术在罕见血管异常的宏AUC分类上实现了小幅但一致的改进，其中对淋巴管扩张的增益最为稳健。

title: Physics-Based iOCT Sonification for Real-time Interaction Awareness in Subretinal Injection
summary: Subretinal injection is a delicate vitreoretinal procedure requiring precise needle placement within the subretinal space while avoiding perforation of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), a layer directly beneath the target with extremely limited regenerative capacity. To enhance depth perception during cannula advancement, intraoperative optical coherence tomography (iOCT) offers high-resolution cross-sectional visualization of needle-tissue interaction; however, interpreting these images requires sustained visual attention alongside the en face microscope view, thereby increasing cognitive load during critical phases and placing additional demands on the surgeon's proprioceptive control. In this paper, we propose a structured, real-time sonification framework designed for extensible mapping of iOCT-derived anatomical features into perceptual auditory feedback. The method employs a physics-inspired acoustic model driven by segmented retinal layers from a stream of iOCT B-scans, with needle motion and injection-induced retinal layer displacements serving as excitation inputs to the sound model, enabling perception of tool position and retinal deformation. In a controlled user study (n=34), the proposed sonification achieved high retinal layer identification accuracy and robust detection of retinal deformation-related events, significantly outperforming a state-of-the-art baseline in overall event identification (83.4% vs. 60.6%, p < 0.001), with gains driven primarily by enhanced detection of injection-induced retinal deformation. Evaluation by experts (n=4) confirmed the clinical relevance and potential intraoperative applicability of the method. These results establish structured iOCT sonification as a viable complementary modality for real-time surgical guidance in subretinal injection.
summary_zh: 视网膜下注射是一种精细的玻璃体视网膜手术，需将针头精准置于视网膜下间隙，同时避免刺穿其下方再生能力极为有限的视网膜色素上皮层。为增强套管推进过程中的深度感知，术中光学相干断层扫描能够以高分辨率横截面可视化呈现针头与组织的交互过程；然而，解读这些图像需要在外科显微镜正面视图之外持续保持视觉注意力，这不仅在关键步骤中增加了认知负荷，还对术者的本体感觉控制能力提出了更高要求。本文提出了一种结构化的实时声化框架，旨在将iOCT获取的解剖特征可扩展地映射为感知听觉反馈。该方法采用物理启发的声学模型，由iOCT连续B扫描分割出的视网膜层结构驱动，将针头运动及注射引起的视网膜层位移作为声学模型的激励输入，从而实现器械位置与视网膜形变的感知。在受控用户研究（n=34）中，该声化方案实现了高精度的视网膜层识别与稳健的视网膜形变事件检测，在整体事件识别率上显著优于现有先进基线方法（83.4% vs. 60.6%，p < 0.001），其优势主要来源于对注射诱导视网膜形变检测能力的提升。专家评估（n=4）证实了该方法的临床相关性及潜在的术中应用价值。这些结果表明，结构化iOCT声化技术可作为视网膜下注射手术中实时引导的可行辅助模式。
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time sonification framework that converts iOCT data into auditory feedback during subretinal injections, using a physics-based acoustic model to convey needle position and retinal deformation. A user study (n=34) showed it significantly outperformed a baseline in event identification accuracy, particularly for detecting injection-induced retinal deformation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实时声化框架，将术中光学相干断层扫描（iOCT）数据在视网膜下注射过程中转化为听觉反馈，使用基于物理的声学模型来传达针头位置和视网膜形变。一项用户研究（n=34）表明，该方法在事件识别准确率上显著优于基线，特别是在检测注射引起的视网膜形变方面。

title: EndoGSim: Physics-Aware 4D Dynamic Endoscopic Scene Simulations via MLLM-Guided Gaussian Splatting
summary: In robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, high-fidelity dynamic endoscopic scene reconstruction and simulation are crucial to enhancing downstream tasks and advancing surgical outcomes. However, existing methods primarily focus on visual reconstruction, lacking physics-based descriptions of the scene required for realistic simulation. We propose a unified framework that achieves physics-aware reconstruction and physical simulation of endoscopic scenes through Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs)-guided Gaussian Splatting. Our approach utilizes 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) integrated with pre-trained segmentation and depth estimation to represent deformable tissues and tools. To achieve automatic inference of physical properties, we introduce an object-wise material field that initializes material parameters via MLLM and refines them through a differentiable Material Point Method (MPM) under joint supervision from rendered images and optical flow. Validated on both open-source and in-house datasets, our framework achieves superior simulation fidelity and physical accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods, underscoring its potential to advance robot-assisted surgical applications.
summary_zh: 在机器人辅助微创手术中，高保真的动态内窥镜场景重建与仿真对于提升下游任务水平、改善手术效果至关重要。然而，现有方法主要侧重于视觉重建，缺乏真实仿真所需的场景物理特性描述。本文提出一种统一框架，通过多模态大语言模型引导的高斯泼溅技术，实现内窥镜场景的物理感知重建与物理仿真。该方法采用融合预训练分割与深度估计的四维高斯泼溅模型，以表征可变形组织与手术器械。为实现物理属性的自动推断，我们引入对象级材质场，通过多模态大语言模型初始化材质参数，并在渲染图像与光流的联合监督下，通过可微分物质点法进行优化。在开源数据集与内部数据集上的验证表明，相较于现有先进方法，本框架在仿真保真度与物理精度方面实现了更优的性能，彰显了其在推动机器人辅助手术应用方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework called EndoGSim that uses MLLM-guided 4D Gaussian Splatting and differentiable physics to create physics-aware, dynamic 4D simulations of endoscopic scenes for improved surgical robot applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为EndoGSim的框架，它利用MLLM引导的4D高斯泼溅和可微物理，为手术机器人应用创建具有物理感知的动态4D内窥镜场景仿真。

title: RoiMAM: Region-of-Interest Medical Attention Model for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) facilitate medical visual question answering (MedVQA) by jointly interpreting images and text. However, existing models typically depend on large architectures and closed-set answers, which limits their efficiency and potential clinical applicability. To overcome these shortcomings, we introduce RoiMAM, an efficient VLM. It integrates a training-free ROI Generation Module with Semantic Selective Suppression to focus on lesion-relevant regions, alongside a Text Prompt Enhancer module that provides modality-specific context without introducing training parameters. Compared to the widely used MedVInT-TD model, our design achieves efficient and accurate diagnosis at less than 20\% of the model size, while improving accuracy by approximately 2% on SLAKE and 4.6% on PMC-VQA.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过联合解析图像与文本，促进了医学视觉问答（MedVQA）的发展。然而，现有模型通常依赖于庞大的架构和封闭式答案集，这限制了其效率和临床应用的潜力。为克服这些不足，我们提出了一种高效视觉语言模型——RoiMAM。该模型融合了免训练的感兴趣区域生成模块与语义选择性抑制机制，以聚焦于病灶相关区域；同时引入文本提示增强模块，在不增加训练参数的情况下提供模态专属的上下文信息。与广泛使用的MedVInT-TD模型相比，我们的设计以不足20%的模型规模实现了高效精准的诊断，同时在SLAKE和PMC-VQA数据集上分别将准确率提升了约2%与4.6%。
tldr: This paper introduces RoiMAM, an efficient vision-language model for medical visual question answering. It uses a training-free ROI Generation Module and a Text Prompt Enhancer to focus on lesion-relevant areas, achieving higher accuracy with a much smaller model size compared to a baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoiMAM，一种用于医学视觉问答的高效视觉-语言模型。它利用无需训练的感兴趣区域生成模块和文本提示增强器，专注于病变相关区域，与基线模型相比，在模型尺寸小得多的情况下实现了更高的准确率。

title: SSTL: Self-Sensing Tendon Loop for Hysteresis Modeling and Compensation in Tendon-Sheath Mechanisms
summary: Flexible endoscopic robots enable minimally invasive access through natural orifices, but their control accuracy is limited by configuration-dependent hysteresis in the tendon-sheath mechanisms (TSMs). Tendon-sheath friction and tendon elasticity induce a systematic discrepancy between the proximal actuation input and distal output, and this discrepancy varies with the insertion tube configuration. To address this challenge, this paper proposes the Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL), a double-pass tendon loop routed through the insertion tube and wrapped around a distal pulley, and returned to the proximal end. The loop structure allows both the input and output tensions of the SSTL to be measured proximally, thereby providing an input-output tension profile without requiring distal force or fiber-optic sensors. Because the SSTL shares the same routing path as the actuation TSM, the two TSMs exhibit strongly correlated hysteresis behaviors. From the SSTL tension profile, a learning-based mapping estimates the configuration-dependent hysteresis parameters of the actuation TSM, which are then used by a feedforward controller to compensate for actuation hysteresis. We validate the proposed method by tracking actuation tendon tension under three different insertion tube configurations. Across sinusoidal and random trajectories, the proposed method reduces average RMSE by 88.1% compared with the uncompensated baseline, achieving 97.8% of the performance of direct identification, which requires direct measurement of the input and output tension profile of the actuation TSM.
summary_zh: 柔性内窥镜机器人能够通过自然腔道实现微创介入，但其控制精度受制于肌腱-鞘管机制中与构型相关的滞后效应。肌腱-鞘管间的摩擦力与肌腱弹性导致近端驱动输入与远端输出之间存在系统性偏差，且该偏差随插入管构型变化而变化。为解决这一问题，本文提出自感肌腱回路——一种双通道肌腱回路，该回路贯穿插入管并绕经远端滑轮后返回近端。其环状结构使得可在近端同步测量SSTL的输入与输出张力，从而无需借助远端力传感器或光纤传感器即可获取输入-输出张力关系曲线。由于SSTL与驱动TSM具有相同的路径布置，两者的滞后行为呈现强相关性。基于SSTL张力曲线，通过学习方法映射可估计驱动TSM中与构型相关的滞后参数，进而由前馈控制器进行滞后补偿。我们在三种不同插入管构型下进行驱动肌腱张力跟踪实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。在正弦与随机轨迹测试中，相较于无补偿基准方案，该方法将平均均方根误差降低了88.1%，达到了直接辨识法（需直接测量驱动TSM的输入-输出张力曲线）97.8%的性能水平。
tldr: This paper proposes a Self-Sensing Tendon Loop (SSTL) to measure and learn the configuration-dependent hysteresis in tendon-sheath actuation of flexible endoscopic robots, enabling feedforward compensation and improving control accuracy significantly.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种自传感腱环（SSTL），用于测量和学习柔性内窥镜机器人中腱鞘驱动的、与构型相关的迟滞特性，并通过前馈补偿显著提高了控制精度。

title: SCARED-C: Corrected Camera Poses for Endoscopic Depth Estimation
summary: The SCARED dataset is a widely used benchmark for endoscopic depth estimation, offering ground-truth 3D reconstructions captured with a structured light sensor. However, the depth maps for non-keyframe images rely on robot kinematics that introduce substantial pose errors, limiting the reliably labeled portion of the dataset to 35 keyframes. We present SCARED-C, a corrected version of the SCARED dataset that expands the number of reliable RGB-D pairs from 35 to 17,135. Our pipeline applies COLMAP, a Structure-from-Motion system, to re-estimate camera poses for all frames, followed by a scale recovery step that aligns the resulting reconstructions to metric space using the ground-truth keyframe depth maps. We validate the corrected poses through (1) stereo disparity evaluation and (2) monocular depth estimation experiments. The corrected dataset and code are publicly released to the community.
summary_zh: SCARED数据集是内窥镜深度估计领域广泛使用的基准数据集，其通过结构光传感器捕获的真实三维重建数据提供了深度真值。然而，非关键帧图像的深度图依赖机器人运动学进行估计，该方法会引入显著位姿误差，使得数据集中可靠标注部分仅限35个关键帧。本文提出SCARED-C——SCARED数据集的校正版本，将可靠RGB-D图像对数量从35帧扩展至17,135帧。我们采用运动恢复结构系统COLMAP重新估计所有帧的相机位姿，随后通过尺度恢复步骤，利用关键帧真实深度图将重建结果对齐至公制空间。校正后的位姿通过以下两种方式验证：(1) 立体视差评估；(2) 单目深度估计实验。校正后的数据集及相关代码已向研究社区公开。
tldr: This paper presents SCARED-C, a corrected version of the SCARED endoscopic depth estimation dataset, where camera poses are re-estimated using Structure-from-Motion (COLMAP) and aligned to metric scale using ground-truth keyframes, expanding the number of reliable RGB-D pairs from 35 to over 17,000.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SCARED-C，这是SCARED内窥镜深度估计数据集的修正版本。该工作使用运动恢复结构（COLMAP）重新估计所有帧的相机位姿，并利用关键帧的真实深度图将重建结果对齐到度量空间，从而将可靠的RGB-D数据对从35个扩展到超过17,000个。

title: Rethinking the State Update Gate for Long-Sequence Recurrent 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction under a strict constant-memory budget hinges on how the recurrent state is updated as the stream evolves. We profile TTT3R-style per-token gates across five benchmarks and discover a structural bottleneck: the gate is intrinsically bounded in magnitude (median $0.31$; never exceeding $0.6$) and nearly frame-invariant, yielding an effective memory horizon of only $\sim$3 frames per state token, which serves as the structural origin of long-sequence drift. We trace this to a missing axis: existing inference-time methods modulate updates only at the per-token, intra-frame level, while the orthogonal frame-level question of \emph{how strongly each frame should contribute to the state} has been treated as content-independent. We close this gap with a scalar frame-level gate $α_t \in (0, 1]$ derived in closed form from frame-to-frame changes of internal features -- a continuous relaxation of classical Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) keyframe selection that requires no parameters, no training, and no extra forward pass. Across six benchmarks spanning camera pose, video depth, and 3D reconstruction at sequence lengths up to $4,541$ frames, our gate cuts ATE by $51\%$ on long TUM-RGBD pose sequences, reduces AbsRel by $12.8\%$ on Bonn video depth, and on KITTI long-sequence pose estimation surpasses both LongStream and Keyframe-VO, while retaining strictly constant memory at zero training cost.
summary_zh: 在严格恒定内存预算下的流式三维重建，其核心在于如何随着数据流演进更新循环状态。我们通过五个基准测试分析了TTT3R式的逐令牌门控机制，发现一个结构性瓶颈：该门控机制在幅度上存在固有上限（中位数0.31，从未超过0.6），且近乎帧不变性，导致每个状态令牌的有效记忆范围仅约3帧，这构成了长序列漂移的结构性根源。我们将其归因于缺失的调控维度：现有推理方法仅在逐令牌的帧内层面调节更新，而关于“每帧应对状态产生多大贡献”这一正交的帧级问题，却被视作与内容无关。我们通过闭式推导的标量帧级门控α_t∈(0,1]填补了这一空白，该参数由内部特征的帧间变化导出——这是对经典即时定位与地图构建（SLAM）关键帧选择的连续松弛，无需参数、训练或额外前向计算。在涵盖相机位姿、视频深度及序列长度高达4,541帧的三维重建的六个基准测试中，我们的门控机制在长序列TUM-RGBD位姿数据上使绝对轨迹误差降低51%，在Bonn视频深度数据集上将绝对相对误差减少12.8%，并在KITTI长序列位姿估计中超越LongStream与Keyframe-VO方法，同时以零训练成本保持严格的恒定内存消耗。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel scalar frame-level gate for recurrent 3D reconstruction models. The gate is derived in closed form from feature changes, requires no training, and significantly improves long-sequence performance by better managing memory state updates.
tldr_zh: 本文为循环3D重建模型提出了一种新颖的标量帧级门控机制。该门控根据特征变化的闭式解推导得出，无需训练，并通过更好地管理内存状态更新，显著提升了长序列任务的性能。

title: DepthPolyp: Pseudo-Depth Guided Lightweight Segmentation for Real-Time Colonoscopy
summary: Accurate polyp segmentation in colonoscopy is essential for early colorectal cancer detection, yet real-world clinical environments pose persistent challenges such as motion blur, specular reflections, and illumination instability. Most existing methods are optimized on clean benchmark images and suffer noticeable performance degradation when deployed in authentic surgical scenarios. We propose DepthPolyp, a lightweight and robust segmentation framework based on pseudo-depth-guided multi-task learning and efficient feature modulation. The architecture combines hierarchical Ghost factorization for compact feature generation, Interleaved Shuffle Fusion for low-cost cross-scale interaction, and Dynamic Group Gating for adaptive group-wise feature weighting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DepthPolyp achieves strong cross-dataset generalization when trained on degraded data and evaluated on both clean and noisy target domains, consistently outperforming lightweight baselines and remaining competitive with substantially larger models. In real surgical video evaluation on PolypGen, DepthPolyp achieves better segmentation performance than models up to $20\times$ larger while preserving real-time inference speed. With only 3.57M parameters and 0.86 GMACs, the proposed method runs at over 180 FPS on mobile devices, making it well suited for real-time deployment in resource-constrained clinical environments. Code and pretrained weights are available at: https://github.com/ReaganWu/DepthPolyp/
summary_zh: 结肠镜图像中的精准息肉分割对早期结直肠癌检测至关重要，但真实临床环境中持续存在的运动模糊、镜面反射和光照不稳定等问题带来严峻挑战。现有方法大多基于洁净基准图像优化，在真实手术场景中部署时会出现显著的性能下降。本研究提出DepthPolyp——一种基于伪深度引导多任务学习与高效特征调制的轻量化鲁棒分割框架。该架构融合了层次化Ghost因子分解以生成紧凑特征、交错式混洗融合实现低成本跨尺度交互，以及动态组门控机制完成自适应分组特征加权。大量实验表明，DepthPolyp在退化数据上训练后，无论在洁净或含噪声目标域上测试均展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力，持续超越轻量化基线模型，并与参数量大得多的模型保持竞争力。在PolypGen真实手术视频评估中，DepthPolyp取得了比参数量大20倍的模型更优的分割性能，同时保持实时推理速度。该方法仅需3.57M参数和0.86 GMACs计算量，在移动设备上运行速度超过180 FPS，非常适合在资源受限的临床环境中进行实时部署。代码与预训练权重已开源：https://github.com/ReaganWu/DepthPolyp/
tldr: This paper proposes DepthPolyp, a lightweight and robust framework for real-time polyp segmentation in colonoscopy videos. It uses pseudo-depth-guided multi-task learning and efficient architectural modules to achieve strong performance on degraded clinical data while being fast enough for mobile deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DepthPolyp，一个用于结肠镜视频实时息肉分割的轻量级、鲁棒性框架。它采用伪深度引导的多任务学习和高效架构模块，在质量较差的临床数据上取得了强性能，同时速度快到足以在移动设备上部署。

title: Rapid Vibration Suppression and Trajectory Tracking of a Serial Manipulator with Multi-Flexible Links
summary: Flexible robotic manipulators (FRMs) offer advantages in lightweight design and large workspace, but their structural flexibility induces vibrations, accelerates fatigue, degrades tracking performance, and limits operational speed. These challenges are further amplified in multi-link serial manipulators, where increased overall length leads to greater structural flexibility. This article presents a backstepping output-feedback framework for fast vibration suppression and tip tracking of an n-degree-of-freedom serial flexible manipulator robot (nDSFMR), with a DeepONet-based approximation for practical deployment. Each link-joint is modeled as a Timoshenko beam coupled with an ODE and transformed into a canonical hyperbolic PDE with boundary dynamics. A backstepping-based boundary controller at the joint is developed to equivalently inject distributed damping along the beam, enabling rapid vibration suppression and trajectory tracking, only using available boundary measurements. To enable real-time implementation and scalability, a DeepONet neural operator is introduced to approximate the backstepping kernels, significantly reducing computational cost and facilitating fast controller updates under varying operating conditions. Experiments on a two-link flexible manipulator demonstrate faster vibration suppression and convergence of the end-effector to the desired trajectory, compared with a linear quadratic regulator (LQR) with feedforward control.
summary_zh: 柔性机器人操纵器（FRMs）具有轻量化设计和大工作空间的优势，但其结构柔性会引发振动、加速疲劳、降低轨迹跟踪性能，并限制操作速度。这些挑战在多连杆串联机械臂中进一步加剧，因为整体长度的增加会导致更大的结构柔性。本文提出一种基于反步法的输出反馈控制框架，用于实现n自由度串联柔性机械臂（nDSFMR）的快速振动抑制与末端跟踪，并通过DeepONet神经网络算子实现实际部署。每个连杆-关节模块被建模为铁木辛柯梁与常微分方程耦合系统，并转化为具有边界动力学的标准双曲型偏微分方程形式。在关节处设计了基于反步法的边界控制器，等效于沿梁注入分布式阻尼，从而仅利用边界测量值即可实现快速振动抑制与轨迹跟踪。为实现实时控制与系统可扩展性，引入DeepONet神经算子近似反步法核函数，显著降低了计算成本，并支持不同工况下的快速控制器更新。在两连杆柔性机械臂上的实验表明，相较于采用前馈控制的线性二次调节器（LQR），该方法能实现更快的振动抑制，并使末端执行器更迅速地收敛至目标轨迹。
tldr: The paper presents a backstepping output-feedback control framework with a DeepONet approximation for real-time vibration suppression and trajectory tracking of multi-link flexible manipulators. It uses boundary measurements to inject distributed damping, achieving faster performance than an LQR controller in experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种采用DeepONet近似反步输出反馈控制框架，用于实现多连杆柔性机械臂的实时振动抑制和轨迹跟踪。该框架仅使用边界测量实现分布式阻尼注入，在实验中比LQR控制器展现了更快的性能。

title: RoboFlow4D: A Lightweight Flow World Model Toward Real-Time Flow-Guided Robotic Manipulation
summary: Planning and acting in 3D environments is a fundamental capability for robotic manipulation in the real world. Although prior work has explored predictive flow planners to guide 3D manipulation, existing approaches often rely on modular pipelines stacking multiple submodels, resulting in high computational overhead and limited real-time performance. To address these challenges, we introduce RoboFlow4D, a lightweight flow world model that unifies perception and planning by estimating temporal motion in physical 3D space. As an end-to-end framework, RoboFlow4D directly predicts multi-frame 3D flows from visual observations and textual instructions, providing explicit flow-based planning to guide action generation. This design allows seamless integration with general action policies, forming an efficient observation-planning-execution closed loop. Through slow-fast collaboration between flow prediction and action control, RoboFlow4D enables real-time and resource-efficient manipulation. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that RoboFlow4D consistently improves manipulation success rates and computational efficiency, advancing flow-guided planning for embodied intelligence.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在三维环境中进行规划与行动是实现现实世界机器人操作的基础能力。尽管已有研究探索利用预测性流规划器来指导三维操作，但现有方法通常依赖于堆叠多个子模型的模块化流程，导致计算开销大且实时性能有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出RoboFlow4D——一种轻量级流世界模型，通过估计物理三维空间中的时空运动，将感知与规划统一起来。作为一个端到端框架，RoboFlow4D能够直接从视觉观察和文本指令中预测多帧三维流，提供基于流的显式规划以指导动作生成。该设计支持与通用动作策略的无缝集成，形成高效的观测-规划-执行闭环。通过流预测与动作控制的缓急协同机制，RoboFlow4D实现了实时且资源高效的操作控制。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，RoboFlow4D能持续提升操作成功率与计算效率，推动基于流规划的具身智能技术发展。
tldr: The paper introduces RoboFlow4D, a lightweight, end-to-end flow world model for robotics. It predicts 3D motion flows from vision and language to guide action generation in real-time, improving manipulation success and computational efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RoboFlow4D，一个轻量级、端到端的机器人流世界模型。它通过视觉和语言输入预测3D运动流，以实时指导动作生成，提升了操作成功率和计算效率。

title: Neural Operators for Design-Space Surrogate Modeling of Tendon-Actuated Continuum Robots
summary: Continuum robots enable dexterous manipulation in constrained environments, but require accurate and efficient models for real-time manipulation and control. Traditional physics-based models can be computationally expensive and may suffer from inaccuracies due to unmodeled effects, while current learning-based methods often generalize poorly beyond the specific robot on which they are trained. We present a formulation of surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as an operator learning problem that maps robot design parameters and tendon actuation inputs to resulting configurations. This formulation enables a single trained model to generalize across a large class of robot designs. We develop four novel neural operator architectures--two based on Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) and two based on Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs)--and train them on simulation data to predict robot configurations. All architectures achieve good accuracy while allowing for fast and accurate generalization across designs. Our results demonstrate that operator learning provides an effective and generalizable surrogate for continuum robot mechanics in the design space, enabling fast modeling for control, planning, and design optimization in surgical and industrial applications.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人能够在受限环境中实现灵巧操作，但需要精确高效的模型以支持实时操控。传统的基于物理的模型计算成本高昂，且可能因未建模效应导致精度不足，而当前基于学习的方法在训练对象之外的机器人上往往泛化能力较差。本文将肌腱驱动连续体机器人的代理建模问题构建为算子学习问题，其目标是将机器人设计参数与肌腱驱动输入映射至最终构型。该框架使得单个训练模型能够泛化至广泛类别的机器人设计。我们开发了四种新型神经算子架构——两种基于深度算子网络，两种基于傅里叶神经算子——并利用仿真数据训练它们以预测机器人构型。所有架构在实现高精度的同时，能够快速准确地在不同设计间泛化。结果表明，算子学习为连续体机器人在设计空间中的力学建模提供了高效且可泛化的代理方案，为手术和工业应用中的控制、路径规划与设计优化实现了快速建模。
tldr: This paper frames surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as an operator learning problem, enabling a single model to generalize across robot designs. It proposes novel neural operator architectures (DeepONet and FNO-based) that achieve accurate and fast configuration prediction for control and planning in surgical/industrial applications.
tldr_zh: 本研究将肌腱驱动连续体机器人的代理建模构建为一个算子学习问题，使得单个模型能够泛化到多种机器人设计。文章提出了新颖的神经算子架构（基于DeepONet和FNO），能够为外科手术/工业应用中的控制和规划，提供快速准确的机器人构型预测。

title: DEFLECT: Delay-Robust Execution via Flow-matching Likelihood-Estimated Counterfactual Tuning for VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically deployed with asynchronous inference: the robot executes a previously predicted action chunk while the model computes the next one. This creates a prediction-execution misalignment: the chunk is conditioned on the observation taken before inference began, but executes in a physical state that has already drifted forward by several control steps; naive asynchronous rollover collapses from 89% to under 1% on Kinetix as the inference cycle covers up to seven control steps. We introduce DEFLECT, a fully offline post-training refinement that applies as a near drop-in upgrade to existing async-VLA stacks by converting latency itself into a label-free preference signal: counterfactual fresh/stale action pairs are constructed from a frozen reference policy and scored under the deployment-time conditioning via an implicit flow-matching likelihood-ratio surrogate, with no human labels, reward models, or online rollouts. DEFLECT substantially extends the usable delay envelope of async VLA control, with +6.4 success-rate gain in the high-latency regime (5-7 control steps), +4.6 when transferred to a real-scale VLA at the longest delay, and consistent improvements on two real-robot tasks (a bimanual conveyor pick-and-place and a reactive whack-a-mole).
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常采用异步推理方式部署：机器人执行先前预测的动作片段时，模型同时计算下一个动作片段。这导致了预测与执行之间的错位：动作片段基于推理开始前获取的观测状态进行条件生成，却在实际物理状态已经向前漂移数个控制步后执行；在Kinetix测试中，当推理周期覆盖多达七个控制步时，朴素的异步递推成功率从89%骤降至不足1%。我们提出DEFLECT方法——一种完全离线的训练后优化方案，能够以近乎即插即用的方式升级现有异步VLA系统。该方法将延迟本身转化为无标签的偏好信号：通过冻结参考策略构建反事实的新鲜/陈旧动作对，并利用隐式流匹配似然比代理在部署时条件评分，整个过程无需人工标注、奖励模型或在线试错。DEFLECT显著扩展了异步VLA控制的可容忍延迟范围，在高延迟场景（5-7个控制步）中实现+6.4%的成功率提升，在最长延迟条件下迁移至真实尺度VLA时获得+4.6%的增益，并在两项真实机器人任务（双机械臂传送带分拣作业与反应式打地鼠任务）中均取得持续的性能改进。
tldr: DEFLECT is a novel, fully offline method for tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies to be robust to the inherent action-execution delays in asynchronous inference setups, without needing human labels, reward models, or online rollouts.
tldr_zh: DEFLECT 是一种新颖的、完全离线的调优方法，用于增强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略对异步推理中固有动作执行延迟的鲁棒性，无需人工标注、奖励模型或在线试错。

title: From swept contact to pose: Probe-aware registration via complementary-shape docking
summary: Accurate registration between a prior model and the real scene is essential for high-precision robotic manipulation, yet optical methods suffer from long calibration chains, line-of-sight constraints, and fabrication errors. We propose a calibration-free alternative that reformulates contact registration as complementary-shape docking between the object and the probe's swept volume, explicitly accounting for probe geometry and leveraging both contact and non-contact evidence. Our solver integrates a global-to-local search via 3D FFT correlation over low-discrepancy SO(3) samples, then followed by continuous SE(3) refinement using Lie-algebra updates and analytic contact sensitivities. This pipeline yields efficient exploration and metric-grade convergence without fragile point correspondences. Simulation across free-form meshes achieved sub-0.04 mm and sub-0.4° accuracy and robustness to pose noise and contact loss. On a tooth-preparation robot, our method attained 0.42 mm and 3.75°, outperforming an optical tracker registration while requiring no external sensors. These results demonstrate a practical and precise registration strategy for surgical and industrial robots.
summary_zh: 精确配准先验模型与真实场景对于高精度机器人操作至关重要，然而光学方法存在标定链长、视线约束及制造误差等问题。我们提出一种免标定替代方案，将接触配准重新表述为物体与探针扫描体积之间的互补形状对接，显式考虑探针几何形状，并同时利用接触与非接触证据。我们的求解器通过基于低差异SO(3)样本的三维FFT相关实现全局到局部搜索，进而采用李代数更新与解析接触灵敏度进行连续SE(3)精细化优化。该流程无需脆弱的点对应关系即可实现高效探索与度量级收敛。在自由曲面网格上的仿真实现了低于0.04毫米和0.4°的精度，并对位姿噪声与接触丢失具有鲁棒性。在牙齿预备机器人上，我们的方法达到0.42毫米和3.75°的精度，优于光学跟踪仪配准，且无需外部传感器。这些结果表明该策略为手术与工业机器人提供了一种实用且精确的配准方案。
tldr: This paper presents a calibration-free, probe-aware registration method that uses complementary-shape docking between an object and a probe's swept volume, achieving sub-millimeter accuracy on a tooth-preparation robot without external sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需标定的、探针感知的配准方法，通过物体与探针扫描体积的互补形状对接，在牙体预备机器人上实现了亚毫米精度，且无需外部传感器。

title: SurgOnAir: Hierarchy-Aware Real-Time Surgical Video Commentary
summary: Understanding surgical workflow in real time is fundamental for intelligent surgical embodiment, where AI systems continuously perceive and respond as surgery proceeds. In the operating room, critical decisions depend on subtle, moment-to-moment changes, such as fine instrument movements and evolving tissue states, where even slight perceptual delays can limit assistance or compromise safety. Yet existing methods remain offline or operate at coarse temporal scales, generating descriptions only after processing clips, preventing immediate reaction. We address this by proposing SurgOnAir, a streaming vision-language model that processes frames sequentially without future access and progressively generates narration tokens as visual input arrives. SurgOnAir achieves fine-grained frame-to-token generation, enabling instant responsiveness to evolving surgical dynamics. Built upon our curated hierarchical dataset SurgOnAir-11k spanning action-, step-, and phase-level supervision, the model is trained to produce multi-level textual responses that reflect the inherent hierarchy of surgical procedures. Furthermore, special transition tokens are generated to explicitly mark state changes, allowing SurgOnAir to capture and signal key workflow transitions as they occur. Experiments show that SurgOnAir enables real-time understanding through a single vision-language model that unifies streaming across multiple hierarchies of the surgical workflow, generating superior and hierarchy-aware narrations. Code and dataset will be public.
summary_zh: 实时理解手术工作流程是实现智能手术体感的基础，在此过程中，AI系统需持续感知手术进程并做出相应响应。在手术室中，关键决策依赖于细微的瞬时变化，例如精密器械的移动和不断演变的组织状态，此时即便是微小的感知延迟也可能限制辅助效果或危及安全。然而现有方法仍停留在离线处理或粗糙时间尺度上，仅在处理完视频片段后生成描述，无法实现即时响应。为此，我们提出SurgOnAir——一种流式视觉语言模型，它能按顺序逐帧处理图像而无需访问未来信息，并在视觉输入到达时逐步生成叙事标记。SurgOnAir实现了细粒度的帧到标记生成，从而能够即时响应不断变化的手术动态。该模型基于我们精心构建的分层数据集SurgOnAir-11k进行训练，该数据集涵盖动作、步骤和阶段三个层级的监督信息，使其能够生成反映手术流程固有层级结构的多级文本响应。此外，模型会生成特殊的转换标记以明确标识状态变化，使SurgOnAir能够捕获并实时指示关键工作流程的转换。实验表明，SurgOnAir通过单一视觉语言模型实现了跨手术工作流程多层级流式理解，生成了更优质且具备层级感知能力的叙述文本。代码和数据集将公开。
tldr: SurgOnAir introduces a streaming vision-language model for real-time surgical video narration, generating hierarchical (action, step, phase) descriptions with explicit transition tokens to capture workflow changes as they occur, outperforming offline methods on a curated dataset.
tldr_zh: SurgOnAir 提出了一种流式视觉-语言模型，用于实时手术视频解说，生成层级化（动作、步骤、阶段）描述，并带有显式转换标记以捕捉发生的工作流变化，在自建数据集上优于离线方法。

title: Modeling and Control of a Pneumatic Morphing Soft Quadrotor based on the SOFA Framework for Dynamic Soft Robotic Simulation
summary: This article presents a novel SOFA based finite element method for the soft body modeling and the corresponding dynamic simulation and control of a pneumatic morphing soft quadrotor. The proposed modeling preserves the physical interpretability and control structure of traditional quadrotor dynamics, while capturing the complex, time-varying behavior of pneumatically actuated soft arms. In SOFA, the soft pneumatically actuated arms are discretized as a tetrahedral mesh following an elastic material law that produces internal forces adequate to the real dynamic behavior of the body. Pneumatic actuation governed by both periodic and error-based control signals is applied within the internal cavities to analyze the morphing capability. Finally, a proportional-integral controller is proposed to study the controlled dynamic behavior and morphing capabilities of the pneumatic arm, wherein the pneumatic actuation to the soft arm is controlled to achieve the desired target position. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed novel modeling framework and the related controller design.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SOFA的有限元新方法，用于气动变形软体四旋翼飞行器的软体建模及其动态仿真与控制。所提出的建模方法保留了传统四旋翼动力学模型的物理解释性与控制结构，同时能够捕捉气动驱动软臂复杂且随时间变化的动态行为。在SOFA中，气动驱动软臂被离散为四面体网格，并遵循弹性材料定律，从而产生与真实物体动态行为相适应的内力。在内部空腔中施加由周期性控制信号和基于误差的控制信号共同驱动的气动作用，以分析其变形能力。最后，提出了一种比例积分控制器，用于研究气动臂的受控动态行为与变形能力，其中通过控制软臂的气动驱动以实现期望的目标位置。仿真结果表明，所提出的新型建模框架及相关控制器设计具有有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a SOFA-based finite element method for modeling and controlling a pneumatic morphing soft quadrotor, enabling dynamic simulation with physical interpretability and effective position control via a PI controller.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SOFA框架的有限元方法，用于建模和控制气动变形软体四旋翼飞行器，实现了具有物理可解释性的动态仿真，并通过PI控制器实现了有效的位姿控制。

title: SpineContextResUNet: A Computationally Efficient Residual UNet for Spine CT Segmentation
summary: Automated segmentation of the vertebral column in Computed Tomography (CT) scans is a prerequisite for pathological assessment and surgical planning. However, state-of-the-art methods, particularly those based on Transformers or large-scale ensembles, demand substantial GPU resources, creating a barrier for clinical adoption in resource-constrained environments or on edge devices. To address this, we introduce SpineContextResUNet, a computationally efficient 3D Residual U-Net designed for rapid spinal localization. Our architecture integrates a lightweight Context Block that employs parallel multi-dilated convolutions to capture long-range anatomical dependencies without the high latency of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) or the memory overhead of Self-Attention mechanisms. Extensive validation on two public benchmarks, VerSe2020 and CTSpine1K, demonstrates that our model achieves a Dice score of 88.17% and 88.13% respectively. To evaluate performance under strict hardware constraints, we compared our model against a bottlenecked SwinUNETR scaled to match our ~1.7M hardware footprint. While the constrained Transformer suffers severe performance degradation due to a lack of spatial inductive biases in a limited-data regime, our CNN-based approach successfully maintains high accuracy. Crucially, heavy baselines like TotalSegmentator fail due to memory exhaustion on commodity hardware (Intel Core i5, 8GB RAM), our model performs robust inference, making it a viable solution for point-of-care diagnostics and deployment on edge platforms like the Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano.
summary_zh: 在计算机断层扫描（CT）中实现脊柱的自动分割是病理评估和手术规划的前提。然而，现有最先进方法，尤其是基于Transformer或大规模集成模型的方法，需要大量GPU资源，这在资源受限环境或边缘设备上构成了临床采用的障碍。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SpineContextResUNet——一种计算高效的3D残差U-Net，专为快速脊柱定位而设计。我们的架构集成了一种轻量级上下文块（Context Block），该模块采用并行多膨胀卷积来捕获长程解剖依赖关系，既避免了循环神经网络（RNN）的高延迟，也避免了自注意力机制的内存开销。在VerSe2020和CTSpine1K两个公开基准上的广泛验证表明，我们的模型分别达到了88.17%和88.13%的Dice评分。为评估严格硬件约束下的性能，我们将模型与经过瓶颈缩放的SwinUNETR（缩放至与我们的~1.7M硬件占用匹配）进行了比较。在数据有限的情况下，受约束的Transformer因缺乏空间归纳偏置而遭受严重的性能下降，而我们的基于CNN的方法成功保持了高精度。关键的是，像TotalSegmentator这样的重型基线由于内存耗尽而无法在普通硬件（Intel Core i5, 8GB RAM）上运行，而我们的模型能够进行稳健的推理，使其成为适用于即时诊断和部署于Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano等边缘平台的可行方案。
tldr: SpineContextResUNet is a lightweight 3D Residual U-Net with a context block using parallel multi-dilated convolutions for efficient spine CT segmentation, achieving competitive accuracy on VerSe2020 and CTSpine1K while running on resource-constrained hardware like the Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano.
tldr_zh: SpineContextResUNet 是一种轻量级的3D残差U-Net，通过使用并行多膨胀卷积的上下文块实现高效的脊柱CT分割，在VerSe2020和CTSpine1K数据集上达到具有竞争力的精度，同时能在如Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano等资源受限的硬件上运行。

title: HalluCXR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models for Chest Radiograph Interpretation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for medical image interpretation, yet they frequently hallucinate, generating clinically plausible but factually incorrect findings that pose direct patient safety risks. We introduce HalluCXR, a benchmark evaluating six architecturally diverse VLMs across 856 stratified MIMIC-CXR chest radiographs and three query types, yielding 15,408 model evaluations. An eight-category hallucination taxonomy with clinical severity ratings and a two-layer detection pipeline are validated against 250 human annotations (auto-detection F1=0.959; LLM judge F1=0.907). We find that 61.9--82.3% of outputs contain hallucinations, with clinically dangerous errors in up to 80.2%. Three key patterns emerge: normal radiographs paradoxically attract the most severe hallucinations, common findings are systematically over-fabricated while rare findings go under-detected, and response length alone predicts hallucination risk (AUC up to 0.908). A six-model ensemble reduces fabrication by up to 84.8% at the cost of increased omission; a three-model subset retains comparable performance at half the cost. These results establish that hallucination auditing, verbosity-based risk monitoring, and ensemble-based safety layers are prerequisites for clinical deployment.
summary_zh: 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地用于医学影像解读，但它们频繁产生幻觉——生成临床看似合理但事实错误的发现，这直接危及患者安全。我们提出HalluCXR基准，在856张分层采样的MIMIC-CXR胸部X光片和三种查询类型上评估了六个架构各异的VLM，共产生15,408次模型评估。基于临床严重性评级的八类幻觉分类法及双层检测管道，经250个人工标注验证（自动检测F1=0.959；大语言模型评判F1=0.907）。研究发现61.9%–82.3%的输出包含幻觉，其中高达80.2%存在临床危险错误。三个关键模式浮现：正常X光片反而引发最严重的幻觉，常见发现被系统性过度编造而罕见发现被漏检，仅响应长度即可预测幻觉风险（AUC高达0.908）。六模型集成可将编造减少84.8%，但以增加遗漏为代价；三模型子集以一半成本保持相当性能。这些结果证实：幻觉审计、基于冗长性的风险监控以及基于集成的安全层是临床部署的前提条件。
tldr: This paper introduces HalluCXR, a benchmark to evaluate and mitigate hallucinations in medical vision-language models for chest X-ray interpretation, finding that over 60% of outputs contain hallucinations and proposing ensemble-based safety layers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HalluCXR基准，用于评估和缓解医学视觉-语言模型在胸部X光片解读中的幻觉现象，发现超过60%的输出包含幻觉，并提出了基于集成模型的安全层。

title: SAM-Sode: Towards Faithful Explanations for Tiny Bacteria Detection
summary: Interpretability in object detection provides crucial confidence support for clinical auxiliary diagnosis. However, in tiny bacteria detection, traditional explanation methods often suffer from blurred foreground boundaries and diffuse feature attribution due to the extreme sparsity of target morphological features and severe interference from complex backgrounds. Such limitations hinder the provision of logically coherent morphological evidence. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel eXplainable AI (XAI) framework, SAM-Sode. The framework innovatively transforms initial feature attribution maps into geometry-aware prompts, leveraging the prior knowledge of the foundation model (SAM3) to achieve spatial refinement and morphological reconstruction of the explanatory mappings. Furthermore, we introduce a dual-constraint mechanism based on physical significance and geometric alignment to perform instance-level denoising, generating coherent explanations that better align with human expert intuition. Experimental results on our self-constructed bacteria dataset with complex circuit backgrounds (containing 2,524 images) and other public datasets demonstrate that the proposed method effectively suppresses background redundancy and significantly enhances the decision-making transparency of tiny object detection.
summary_zh: 可解释性在目标检测中为临床辅助诊断提供了关键的置信支持。然而，在微小细菌检测中，由于目标形态特征的极端稀疏性以及复杂背景的严重干扰，传统解释方法常面临前景边界模糊与特征归因弥散的问题。这类局限性阻碍了逻辑连贯的形态学证据的生成。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种新型可解释人工智能（XAI）框架——SAM-Sode。该框架创新性地将初始特征归因图转化为几何感知提示，利用基础模型（SAM³）的先验知识实现解释性映射的空间细化与形态重建。此外，我们引入了一种基于物理意义与几何对齐的双约束机制，执行实例级去噪，生成更符合人类专家直觉的连贯解释。在我们自建的含复杂电路背景的细菌数据集（包含2,524张图像）及其他公开数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法有效抑制了背景冗余，显著提升了微小目标检测的决策透明度。
tldr: Proposes SAM-Sode, an XAI framework that uses SAM's prior knowledge to refine feature attribution maps for tiny bacteria detection, enabling spatially coherent and morphologically meaningful explanations.
tldr_zh: 提出了SAM-Sode框架，利用SAM基础模型的先验知识对微小细菌检测中的特征归因图进行空间细化和形态重建，生成连贯且符合人类专家直觉的可解释性映射。

title: Embedding-Based Federated Learning with Runtime Governance for Iron Deficiency Prediction
summary: Recent reviews find that the vast majority of published healthcare federated learning (FL) studies never reach real-world deployment. We developed an embedding-based FL pipeline for iron deficiency prediction from routine full blood count (FBC) data and deployed it across real institutional environments at Amsterdam University Medical Centre (AUMC) and NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT), two clinical environments that differ markedly in iron deficiency prevalence, ferritin distribution, and subject populations. A frozen domain-specific haematology foundation model, DeepCBC, performs site-local representation extraction, restricting federated training to a compact downstream classifier and substantially reducing recurrent communication relative to full-encoder federation. The two clinical datasets are structurally not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), with heterogeneity arising from distinct population differences rather than sampling artefacts. Runtime governance is enforced by FLA$^3$, a healthcare-oriented FL platform providing study-scoped execution, policy-based authorisation, and signed audit logging. Standard sample-size-weighted aggregation (FedAvg) reduced the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) at both sites relative to local-only training, as the global update was biased towards the larger AUMC distribution. FedMAP, a personalised aggregation method, raised ROC-AUC from 0.9470 to 0.9594 at AUMC and from 0.8558 to 0.8671 at NHSBT relative to local-only training, achieving the highest macro ROC-AUC of 0.9133 and the best macro balanced accuracy overall. These results support personalised aggregation in clinical federations where client sample size and task relevance diverge substantially.
summary_zh: 摘要：近期综述指出，已发表的医疗领域联邦学习（FL）研究绝大多数从未实现实际部署。我们开发了一种基于嵌入的FL流程，用于从常规全血计数（FBC）数据预测缺铁性贫血，并将其部署在阿姆斯特丹大学医学中心（AUMC）和英国国家医疗服务体系血液与移植中心（NHSBT）的真实机构环境中。这两个临床环境在缺铁性贫血患病率、铁蛋白分布及受试人群方面存在显著差异。冷冻领域特异性血液学基础模型DeepCBC负责局部特征提取，将联邦训练限制为一个紧凑的下游分类器，相比全编码器联邦，大幅减少了反复通信开销。两个临床数据集结构上非独立同分布（non-IID），异质性源于不同人群差异而非采样伪影。运行时治理由面向医疗的FL平台FLA$^3$强制执行，该平台提供研究范围限定的执行、基于策略的授权以及带签名的审计日志记录。与仅本地训练相比，标准样本量加权聚合（FedAvg）在两个站点均降低了受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC），因为全局更新偏向于规模更大的AUMC数据分布。个性化聚合方法FedMAP将AUMC的ROC-AUC从0.9470提升至0.9594，NHSBT的ROC-AUC从0.8558提升至0.8671，实现了最高的宏平均ROC-AUC（0.9133）以及整体最佳宏平均准确率。这些结果支持在客户端样本量和任务相关性差异显著的临床联邦中采用个性化聚合方法。
tldr: This paper presents an embedding-based federated learning pipeline using a frozen haematology foundation model and personalized aggregation (FedMAP) to predict iron deficiency across two heterogeneous clinical sites, demonstrating improved ROC-AUC over local-only training and standard FedAvg.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于嵌入的联邦学习流水线，使用冻结的血液学基础模型和个性化聚合方法（FedMAP）在两个异质临床站点预测铁缺乏，相比本地训练和标准FedAvg提高了ROC-AUC。

title: Q-SpiRL: Quantum Spiking Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Robot Navigation
summary: Adaptive robot navigation in dynamic environments requires policies that can reach the target reliably while producing efficient and stable trajectories. This paper presents Q-SpiRL, a quantum spiking reinforcement learning framework for obstacle-aware robot navigation. The framework develops and evaluates five agent families: tabular Q-learning, classical MLP, classical SNN, quantum-enhanced MLP (QMLP), and quantum-enhanced spiking neural network (QSNN). While all models are implemented under a unified training and evaluation pipeline, the QSNN is the central architecture of interest, as it combines spike-based temporal processing with variational quantum feature transformation. Experiments are conducted across three grid-world environments of increasing size, namely 20x20, 30x30, and 40x40, with both static and dynamic obstacles. Performance is assessed using success rate, success-weighted path length, path length, and turn rate under deterministic inference. Results show that QSNN achieves the strongest overall trade-off between task completion, trajectory efficiency, and motion smoothness, reaching up to 99% success rate while maintaining high path efficiency in the most challenging setting. Execution on IBM quantum hardware further demonstrates the feasibility of deploying the proposed hybrid policy under real-device conditions.
summary_zh: 摘要：在动态环境中实现自适应机器人导航，需要策略既能可靠到达目标，又能生成高效且稳定的轨迹。本文提出Q-SpiRL——一种面向障碍物感知机器人导航的量子脉冲强化学习框架。该框架开发并评估了五类智能体：表格型Q学习、经典MLP、经典SNN、量子增强MLP（QMLP）以及量子增强脉冲神经网络（QSNN）。所有模型均在统一的训练和评估流程下实现，其中QSNN是核心架构，因为它将基于脉冲的时序处理与变分量子特征变换相结合。实验在三种规模递增的网格世界环境（20×20、30×30和40×40）中进行，同时包含静态和动态障碍物。性能评估采用确定性推理下的成功率、成功率加权路径长度、路径长度和转向率。结果表明，QSNN在任务完成度、轨迹效率与运动平滑性之间实现了最佳整体权衡，在最具挑战性的场景下成功率高达99%，同时保持了较高的路径效率。在IBM量子硬件上的执行进一步证明了所提出的混合策略在真实设备条件下部署的可行性。
tldr: This paper presents Q-SpiRL, a quantum spiking reinforcement learning framework for adaptive robot navigation in grid-world environments, achieving up to 99% success rate with the quantum-enhanced spiking neural network (QSNN) and demonstrating feasibility on IBM quantum hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Q-SpiRL，一种量子尖峰强化学习框架，用于网格世界环境中的自适应机器人导航，其中量子增强尖峰神经网络（QSNN）达到了高达99%的成功率，并展示了在IBM量子硬件上的可行性。

title: Automated ICD Classification of Psychiatric Diagnoses: From Classical NLP to Large Language Models
summary: Mental health has become a global priority, leading to a massive administrative burden in the coding of clinical diagnoses. This study proposes the automation of psychiatric diagnostic analysis by mapping free-text descriptions to the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Utilizing a specialized dataset of 145,513 Spanish psychiatric descriptions, various text representation paradigms were evaluated, ranging from classical frequency-based models (BoW, TF-IDF) to state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) such as e5\_large, BioLORD, and Llama-3-8B. Results indicate that transformer-based embeddings consistently outperform traditional methods by capturing implicit semantic cues and nuanced medical terminology. The e5\_large model, through end-to-end fine-tuning, achieved the highest performance with a $F1_{micro}$ score of 0.866. This research demonstrates that adapting LLMs to specific clinical nomenclature is essential for overcoming the challenges of ``long-tail'' label distributions and the inherent ambiguity of psychiatric discourse.
summary_zh: 心理健康已成为全球优先关注的事项，导致临床诊断编码面临巨大的行政负担。本研究提出通过自然语言处理（NLP）和机器学习（ML）技术，将自由文本描述映射至《国际疾病分类》（ICD），从而实现精神科诊断分析的自动化。利用包含145,513条西班牙语精神科描述的专业数据集，本研究评估了多种文本表示范式，从经典的基于频率的模型（BoW、TF-IDF）到前沿的大型语言模型（LLM），如e5\_large、BioLORD和Llama-3-8B。结果表明，基于Transformer的嵌入方法通过捕捉隐含语义线索和细微医学术语，始终优于传统方法。e5\_large模型通过端到端微调取得了最高性能，F1微观分数（$F1_{micro}$）达到0.866。本研究证明，使LLM适应特定的临床术语体系对于克服精神科话语中“长尾”标签分布及固有歧义性所带来的挑战至关重要。
tldr: This paper evaluates classical NLP and large language models for automating ICD coding of psychiatric diagnoses from Spanish free-text descriptions, finding that fine-tuned transformer-based models (e5_large) achieve the best performance (F1=0.866).
tldr_zh: 本研究评估了从经典NLP到大语言模型在将西班牙语自由文本描述自动编码为精神科诊断ICD代码中的表现，发现经过微调的基于Transformer的模型（e5_large）取得了最佳性能（F1=0.866）。

title: SDFStent: Real-time interactive virtual stenting via SDF deformation fields
summary: Stenting is among the most common transcatheter interventions for congenital heart disease (CHD). Patient-specific computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations can predict hemodynamic outcomes of intervention scenarios but require post-operative vascular geometries that reflect stent-induced shape changes, which existing tools either model inadequately or require extensive time or manual effort to generate. We present SDFStent, a signed distance function (SDF) based mesh deformation method for virtual stenting that operates in real time, maintains mesh integrity, and preserves junction geometry. The stent is modeled as a pipe surface composed of piecewise-capsule SDFs joined by a smooth-minimum operator. Mesh vertices near the expanding SDF surface are displaced along the SDF gradient with a compactly supported fall-off function and an alpha blending mask. SDFStent was benchmarked against three existing approaches and validated on three tetralogy of Fallot (ToF) patients and three coarctation of the aorta (CoA) patients using rigid-wall steady-state CFD simulations against clinical catheterization measurements. Against a prescribed diameter of 6.0 mm, the method produced a mean stented diameter of 5.92 $\pm$ 0.08 mm in 1.5 s, over 100$\times$ faster than the best stenting-specific comparator. All output meshes were watertight and self-intersection-free. CFD-simulated post-operative pressure drops agreed with clinical measurements within 4 mmHg (mean error 2 mmHg). SDFStent produces simulation-ready post-stent models that match prescribed stent dimensions at interactive speeds, from pre-operative anatomy and catheterization data alone. The implementation is open-source and available in 3D Slicer. Its scriptable architecture enables automated generation of large synthetic cohorts for data-driven surrogate modeling.
summary_zh: 支架植入术是先天性心脏病（CHD）最常见的经导管介入治疗手段之一。基于患者特异性计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟可预测介入方案的血液动力学结果，但需获得反映支架所致形状变化的术后血管几何结构，而现有工具要么建模不充分，要么需要大量时间或手动操作。我们提出SDFStent——一种基于符号距离函数（SDF）的网格变形方法，用于虚拟支架植入，该方法可实时运行、保持网格完整性并保留连接处几何形态。支架被建模为由分段胶囊状SDF通过平滑最小值算子连接的管状曲面。扩展的SDF表面附近的网格顶点沿SDF梯度位移，并采用紧支撑衰减函数与Alpha混合掩膜。SDFStent与三种现有方法进行了基准对比，并在三名法洛四联症（ToF）患者和三名主动脉缩窄（CoA）患者中，通过刚性壁稳态CFD模拟与临床导管测量值进行了验证。在预设直径为6.0 mm的条件下，该方法在1.5秒内产生平均支架内径为5.92±0.08 mm，速度比最佳专用支架模拟器快100倍以上。所有输出网格均为水密且无自相交。CFD模拟的术后压降与临床测量值差异在4 mmHg以内（平均误差2 mmHg）。SDFStent仅凭术前解剖结构及导管数据，即可在交互速度下生成与预设支架尺寸匹配的、可直接用于仿真的术后支架模型。该实现为开源，并可在3D Slicer中使用。其脚本化架构可自动生成大规模合成队列，用于数据驱动的替代建模。
tldr: SDFStent is a real-time, SDF-based mesh deformation method for virtual stenting that produces patient-specific post-stent geometries for CFD simulations, validated on congenital heart disease cases with high speed and accuracy.
tldr_zh: SDFStent是一种基于符号距离函数（SDF）的实时网格变形方法，用于虚拟支架植入，能生成患者特异性支架后几何模型用于CFD模拟，在先天性心脏病病例上验证了其高速和高精度。

title: How can reasoning capability empower the AI copilot robot in endoscopic surgery
summary: Reasoning capability has significantly advanced complex logical inference and robotic decision-making in general domains. However, its potential in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) copilot robot-particularly implemented based on the Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model-remains unexplored in endoscopic surgery. Effective reasoning should enable AI copilot robots to integrate multimodal cues, interpret surgical intent, and infer hidden tissue dynamics, thereby alleviating intraoperative uncertainty and cognitive burden on surgeons. Properly implemented, reasoning-driven autonomy can transform AI copilot robots from reactive executors into cognitive collaborators, enhancing precision, safety, and sustainability in clinical practice.
summary_zh: 推理能力显著提升了通用领域中的复杂逻辑推理和机器人决策水平。然而，其在人工智能（AI）副驾驶机器人——特别是基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型实现的机器人——内镜手术中的潜力仍有待探索。有效的推理应使AI副驾驶机器人能够整合多模态线索、解读手术意图并推断隐藏的组织动力学，从而减轻术中不确定性和外科医生的认知负担。若实施得当，由推理驱动的自主性可将AI副驾驶机器人从被动执行者转变为认知协作者，提升临床实践的精准性、安全性和可持续性。
tldr: This paper explores how reasoning capability can empower Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for AI copilot robots in endoscopic surgery, aiming to transform them from reactive executors into cognitive collaborators to reduce surgeons' cognitive burden and improve precision and safety.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了推理能力如何赋能内镜手术中基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的AI副驾驶机器人，旨在将其从反应性执行者转变为认知协作伙伴，以减轻外科医生的认知负担并提升精准性与安全性。

title: Case-Aware Medical Image Classification with Multimodal Knowledge Graphs and Reliability-Guided Refinement
summary: Deep learning has brought significant progress to medical image classification, yet most existing methods still rely on isolated visual evidence and cannot effectively leverage similar cases or external knowledge. In clinical practice, diagnosis is typically supported by historical similar cases and their associated symptoms. To simulate this diagnostic process, we propose a framework that performs case-aware reasoning using multimodal knowledge graphs for explainable medical image diagnosis. Given an input image, our method constructs a multimodal knowledge graph from adaptively retrieved similar cases, enabling more effective utilization of related samples. We further introduce a knowledge propagation and injection mechanism, where an image-centric Graph Attention Network propagates knowledge semantics to obtain case-based features, followed by a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism that injects these features into visual representations for cross-modal alignment. To mitigate noisy retrieval, we design a confidence-calibrated decision refinement scheme that estimates the reliability of each retrieved case by jointly considering prediction confidence and sample similarity, adaptively adjusting its contribution to the final prediction and providing interpretable case-level evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple medical imaging datasets show that our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MKG-CARE-8B7B.
summary_zh: 深度学习为医学图像分类带来了显著进展，但现有方法大多仍依赖孤立的视觉证据，无法有效利用相似病例或外部知识。临床实践中，诊断通常依赖于历史相似病例及其相关症状。为模拟这一诊断过程，我们提出了一种框架，通过多模态知识图谱进行病例感知推理，实现可解释的医学图像诊断。给定输入图像，该方法从自适应检索的相似病例中构建多模态知识图谱，从而更有效地利用相关样本。我们进一步引入知识传播与注入机制：首先，以图像为中心的图注意力网络传播知识语义以获取基于病例的特征；随后，通过双向跨模态注意力机制将这些特征注入视觉表示，实现跨模态对齐。为减轻检索噪声，我们设计了一种置信度校准的决策优化方案，通过联合考虑预测置信度和样本相似性来评估每个检索病例的可靠性，自适应调整其对最终预测的贡献，并提供可解释的病例级证据。在多个医学影像数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法持续优于强基线模型，消融研究验证了每个组件的有效性。源代码已公开于 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MKG-CARE-8B7B。
tldr: This paper proposes a case-aware medical image classification framework that constructs multimodal knowledge graphs from retrieved similar cases, propagates knowledge via a Graph Attention Network, aligns cross-modal features, and refines predictions with a reliability-guided scheme to handle noisy retrieval.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种案例感知的医学图像分类框架，通过检索相似案例构建多模态知识图谱，利用图注意力网络传播知识，进行跨模态对齐，并通过可靠性引导的方案优化预测，以处理检索噪声。

title: ChronoMedicalWorld: A Medical World Model for Learning Patient Trajectories from Longitudinal Care Data
summary: Long-horizon clinical simulation -- predicting how a patient's physiology evolves over years under specified interventions -- is central to chronic-disease care, yet existing electronic health record (EHR) models are predominantly discriminative, and general-purpose large language models drift under repeated interventions. We propose the \textbf{ChronoMedicalWorld Model (CMWM)}, an action-conditioned latent world-model framework for learning patient trajectories from longitudinal care data. CMWM couples a joint-embedding state encoder with a wide action encoder that admits both structured intervention indicators and free-text communication embeddings, and trains a recurrent latent transition module under a six-term objective: next-observation supervision, next-latent prediction, SIGReg latent regularisation, and three physiology-aware shape priors (slope, continuity, large-jump penalty). A closed-loop rollout-prefix protocol matches training to deployment, so the model is optimised against the same multi-step error it exhibits at inference. As a concrete case study, we instantiate CMWM for annual estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) trajectory forecasting in chronic kidney disease (CKD). On a 2{,}232-patient nephrology cohort, the CKD instantiation achieves a dynamic-50\% history rollout test mean absolute error (MAE) of 7.384 and root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.256, against 7.964 and 11.069 for a tuned GPT-5.5 structured-prompting baseline ($-7.28\%$ MAE, $-7.35\%$ RMSE), with the gain dominated by the dialogue portion of patient--health-coach communication. The framework is not CKD-specific: its architecture, loss design, and training protocol apply to any chronic condition that can be cast as periodic clinical state interleaved with structured and conversational interventions.
summary_zh: 长期临床模拟——预测患者在特定干预措施下生理状况在数年内的演变——是慢性病护理的核心，但现有的电子健康记录模型主要具有判别性，而通用大语言模型在重复干预下会出现漂移。我们提出**医学时间世界模型（CMWM）**，这是一种基于动作条件约束的潜在世界模型框架，用于从纵向护理数据中学习患者轨迹。CMWM将联合嵌入状态编码器与宽动作编码器耦合，后者可接收结构化干预指标和自由文本沟通嵌入，并在六项目标函数下训练循环潜在转移模块：下一观测监督、下一潜在预测、SIGReg潜在正则化以及三项生理感知形状先验（斜率、连续性、大幅跳跃惩罚）。闭环展开前缀协议使训练与部署相匹配，从而模型针对推理时呈现的相同多步误差进行优化。作为具体案例研究，我们将CMWM应用于慢性肾病的年度估算肾小球滤过率轨迹预测。在包含2,232名患者的肾脏病学队列中，该慢性肾病实例化在动态50%历史展开测试中实现平均绝对误差7.384、均方根误差10.256，而经过调优的GPT-5.5结构化提示基线为7.964和11.069（MAE降低7.28%，RMSE降低7.35%），其优势主要来自患者与健康教练沟通的对话部分。该框架并非慢性肾病专用：其架构、损失设计和训练协议适用于任何可表示为周期性临床状态与结构化和对话式干预交错的慢性疾病。
tldr: Presents ChronoMedicalWorld (CMWM), an action-conditioned latent world-model for long-horizon clinical simulation from EHR data, which outperforms GPT-5.5 on CKD eGFR trajectory forecasting.
tldr_zh: 提出了ChronoMedicalWorld（CMWM），一种基于动作条件的潜在世界模型，用于从EHR数据中进行长期临床模拟，在慢性肾病eGFR轨迹预测上优于GPT-5.5。

title: Look-Closer-Then-Diagnose: Confidence-Aware Ultrasound VQA via Active Zooming
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced medical visual question answering, yet their performance in ultrasound remains suboptimal. In clinical practice, sonographers explicitly focus on lesion regions to formulate reports, though diagnostic interpretations sometimes vary due to inherent subjectivity. However, existing VLMs are not explicitly structured to interactively zoom into lesions prior to diagnosis; moreover, they typically treat annotations as unbiased ground truths, failing to account for their inherent subjectivity and ambiguity. In this paper, we propose a framework specifically designed to consider the sonographer's cognitive workflow. We first introduce a structured Zoom-then-Diagnose paradigm, which replicates the interactive search process to enable lesion-focused reasoning. Furthermore, within the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework, we introduce an uncertainty-aware reward derived from stochastic group-wise rollouts to estimate prediction consistency as a proxy for model confidence. Together, these two components encourage the model to reinforce accurate predictions on clear cases while remaining cautious under ambiguity. Experiments across liver, breast, and thyroid datasets show that our framework improves lesion localization by 39.3\%, demonstrating that our model has learned the ability to actively look closer and diagnose.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在医学视觉问答领域取得了显著进展，但在超声影像上的表现仍不理想。临床实践中，超声技师会明确聚焦病灶区域以撰写报告，但诊断解读有时因固有的主观性而存在差异。然而，现有VLM并未明确设计为在诊断前交互式放大观察病灶；此外，它们通常将标注视为无偏的金标准，未能考虑其固有的主观性和模糊性。本文提出一个专门针对超声技师认知工作流的框架。我们首先引入结构化的"先放大后诊断"范式，通过模拟交互式搜索过程实现以病灶为中心的推理。进一步地，在组相对策略优化（GRPO）框架内，我们提出一种基于随机组 rollout 的不确定性感知奖励，将预测一致性作为模型置信度的代理指标。这两个组件共同促使模型在清晰病例上强化准确预测，同时在模糊场景下保持谨慎。在肝脏、乳腺和甲状腺数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架将病灶定位提升39.3%，证明模型已学会主动聚焦并诊断的能力。
tldr: A confidence-aware ultrasound VQA framework that mimics sonographers by actively zooming into lesions before diagnosis, using an uncertainty-aware reward derived from GRPO to handle annotation subjectivity and improve lesion localization significantly.
tldr_zh: 一种置信度感知的超声视觉问答框架，通过模拟超声医师主动放大病灶后再诊断，并利用GRPO中的不确定性感知奖励处理标注主观性，显著提升了病灶定位能力。

title: GLeVE: Graph-Guided Lesion Grounding with Proposal Verification in 3D CT
summary: Grounding radiology report descriptions to 3D CT volumes is essential for verifiable clinical interpretation, yet remains challenging due to the semantic-spatial gap between free-text narratives and volumetric anatomy. Existing report-assisted and vision-language grounding methods typically rely on phrase-level alignment or dense pixel supervision, resulting in limited lesion-wise correspondence and suboptimal localization accuracy. We propose GLeVE, a graph-guided lesion grounding framework with anatomical prior verification and octree-based autoregressive refinement. GLeVE treats each lesion description as an atomic semantic unit and encodes organ attribution, attributes, and inter-lesion relations through relation-aware graph reasoning to produce discriminative lesion-wise queries. Anatomy-aware proposal generation with region-level verification enforces one-to-one text-lesion alignment, while hierarchical octree refinement progressively improves boundary delineation.
